Pernyataan

Informasi yang disajikan dalam Laporan Keberlanjutan PT Bank Permata Tbk (“Permata Bank” atau “Bank”) mencakup pengungkapan kinerja dan strategi Bank pada aspek ekonomi, lingkungan, sosial, serta tata kelola keberlanjutan. Laporan ini merupakan bagian dari Laporan Tahunan yang disusun dan dipublikasikan secara terpisah. Kecuali untuk informasi yang bersifat historis, sejumlah pengungkapan dalam laporan ini termasuk dalam kategori pernyataan ke depan sebagaimana diatur dalam ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku. Pernyataan tersebut bersifat prospektif dan mengandung risiko serta ketidakpastian, sehingga hasil atau kondisi aktual di masa mendatang dapat berbeda secara material dari yang diungkapkan.

Disclaimer

The information presented in the Sustainability Report of PT Bank Permata Tbk (“Permata Bank” or “Bank”) includes disclosures of the Bank’s performance and strategies in economic, environmental, social, and sustainability governance aspects. This report is part of the Annual Report, which is prepared and published separately. Except for historical information, a number of disclosures in this report are included in the category of forward-looking statements as regulated by applicable laws and regulations. These statements are prospective in nature and involve risks and uncertainties, therefore actual results or conditions in the future may differ materially from those disclosed.

# Empowering Values, Sustaining the Future

Permata Bank memperkuat nilai-nilai sosial, lingkungan, dan tata kelola sebagai fondasi keberlanjutan yang kokoh; tidak hanya sebagai komitmen tetapi diwujudkan melalui manifestasi nilai-nilai tersebut ke dalam praktik bisnis, operasional, dan tata kelola yang akuntabel. Melalui pemberdayaan komunitas, perluasan inklusi keuangan, serta penerapan prinsip ESG yang konsisten, setiap inisiatif kami diwujudkan untuk memberikan kontribusi nyata dan berkelanjutan bagi masyarakat.

Di sisi lain, strategi keberlanjutan jangka panjang kami terus disempurnakan guna meningkatkan ketahanan dan daya adaptasi dalam menghadapi dinamika global. Penguatan efisiensi operasional, inovasi yang bertanggung jawab, dan tata kelola yang transparan menjadi pilar penting dalam menyeimbangkan pertumbuhan bisnis dengan tanggung jawab sosial dan lingkungan. Melalui komitmen ini, kami berperan aktif dalam membangun masa depan yang lebih inklusif, stabil, dan berkelanjutan.

Permata Bank reinforces social, environmental, and governance values as a robust foundation for sustainability, transcending mere commitment to be deeply embedded within its business, operational and accountable governance practices. Through community empowerment, the expansion of financial inclusion, and the consistent integration of ESG principles into business processes, each initiative is designed to deliver measurable, long-term value to society.

In parallel, we are continuously enhancing our long-term sustainability strategy to bolster resilience and adaptability amid an evolving global landscape. By strengthening operational efficiency, championing responsible innovation, and upholding transparent governance, we strike a crucial balance between business growth and social and environmental responsibilities. This integrated approach underscores our active role in building a more inclusive, stable, and sustainable future.

“Permata Bank memperluas perannya dalam mendukung sektor berwawasan lingkungan melalui pendekatan risiko dan pembiayaan yang lebih terukur sepanjang 2025, sejalan dengan meningkatnya kebutuhan pembiayaan untuk mendorong transisi menuju ekonomi rendah karbon.”

“Permata Bank expanded its role in supporting environmentally friendly sectors through a more measurable risk and financing approach throughout 2025, in line with rising financing needs to drive the transition towards a low carbon economy.”

## Pemangku kepentingan yang terhormat,

Sepanjang 2025, Permata Bank terus memperkuat perannya sebagai institusi keuangan yang mengintegrasikan prinsip keberlanjutan ke dalam strategi bisnis dan pengambilan keputusan. Dengan mencermati dinamika risiko dan peluang usaha yang semakin kompleks, Bank fokus pada upaya penguatan pembiayaan sesuai prinsip keuangan berkelanjutan, pengembangan solusi keuangan yang mendukung transisi ekonomi, serta pengelolaan risiko iklim. Integrasi aspek Lingkungan, Sosial, dan Tata Kelola (LST) dalam kegiatan usaha, yang sejalan dengan arah pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB), dilakukan melalui perluasan pembiayaan inklusif, serta dukungan terhadap upaya penurunan emisi dalam operasional Bank.

## Dear respected stakeholders,

Throughout 2025, Permata Bank continued to strengthen its role as a financial institution that integrates sustainability principles into business strategy and decision-making. In response to increasingly complex risk and business opportunity dynamics, the Bank focused on strengthening financing aligned with sustainable finance principles, developing financial solutions that support the economic transition, and managing climate risk. The integration of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) aspects into business activities, aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), was carried out through the expansion of inclusive financing and support for emission reduction efforts in the Bank's operations.

PENERAPAN KEUANGAN BERKELANJUTAN

Permata Bank melanjutkan penguatan penerapan keuangan berkelanjutan sebagai bagian dari strategi pertumbuhan yang berimbang antara kinerja bisnis dan tanggung jawab LST. Bank akan meneruskan pengembangan usaha dengan fokus pada kualitas pertumbuhan yang selaras dengan prinsip kehati-hatian, pengelolaan risiko, serta penciptaan nilai jangka panjang bagi seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

Dari sisi kinerja ekonomi, hingga akhir 2025 total kredit yang disalurkan Permata Bank mencapai Rp164,24 triliun, meningkat dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Pendapatan operasional tercatat sebesar Rp12,55 triliun, naik dari Rp12,08 triliun pada 2024, sementara laba bersih mencapai Rp3,59 triliun, menunjukkan kinerja yang stabil di tengah dinamika kondisi perekonomian global. Pertumbuhan ditopang oleh penguatan penyaluran kredit yang selektif, peningkatan kualitas aset, serta pengelolaan dana pihak ketiga yang mencapai Rp193,03 triliun.

Dalam mendukung agenda keuangan berkelanjutan, Permata Bank mencatat pertumbuhan signifikan pada portofolio pembiayaan Kategori Kegiatan Usaha Berkelanjutan (KKUB). Hingga akhir 2025, total portofolio KKUB mencapai Rp30,1 triliun, meningkat 33,3% dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya, dengan kontribusi utama berasal dari pembiayaan Kegiatan Usaha Berwawasan Lingkungan (KUBL) sebesar Rp24,9 triliun. Portofolio tersebut setara dengan 18,49% dari total kredit Bank, meningkat dibandingkan 14,73% pada 2024.

Sepanjang 2025, pembiayaan KUBL difokuskan pada sektor-sektor yang memberikan dampak lingkungan positif, seperti energi terbarukan, pengendalian polusi, pengelolaan keanekaragaman hayati dan penggunaan lahan berkelanjutan, transportasi ramah lingkungan, serta bangunan berwawasan lingkungan. Penguatan portofolio hijau ini didukung oleh pembiayaan kendaraan listrik, properti ramah lingkungan, pembiayaan sindikasi dengan mekanisme sustainability-linked loan, serta penempatan dana pada instrumen obligasi berkelanjutan. Bank juga menyalurkan pembiayaan kepada Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM) sebesar Rp5,2 triliun guna memperluas akses layanan keuangan dan mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi yang lebih merata.

Dalam aspek operasional, Permata Bank memperkuat penerapan praktik ramah lingkungan melalui efisiensi energi dan pengurangan emisi. Implementasi penggantian lampu LED, pengaturan sistem pendingin ruangan, kampanye hemat energi, serta penguatan budaya keberlanjutan mendorong penurunan emisi cakupan 1 dan 2 sebesar 4,90% dibandingkan 2024. Upaya ini menjadi bagian dari langkah Bank dalam mencapai target net zero emission (NZE), yaitu NZE cakupan 1 dan 2 dari aktivitas operasional pada 2030, serta NZE dari aktivitas pembiayaan pada 2052. Di 2025, Permata Bank juga memperoleh dua sertifikasi GREENSHIP dengan peringkat GOLD dari Green Building Council Indonesia untuk Gedung Permata Bank Bintaro Sektor 7 Tangerang Selatan dan Gedung Permata Bank Merdeka Bandung, yang menegaskan upaya Bank dalam meningkatkan standar bangunan hijau dan efisiensi operasional.

SUSTAINABLE FINANCE IMPLEMENTATION

Permata Bank continued to strengthen sustainable finance implementation as part of a balanced growth strategy between business performance and ESG responsibilities. The Bank will continue to develop its business with a focus on quality growth aligned with prudential principles, risk management, and long-term value creation for all stakeholders.

From an economic performance perspective, as of the end of 2025 total loans disbursed by Permata Bank reached IDR 164.24 trillion, increasing compared to the previous year. Operating income was recorded at IDR 12.55 trillion, up from IDR 12.08 trillion in 2024, while net profit reached IDR 3.59 trillion, reflecting stable performance amid evolving global economic conditions. Growth was supported by selective loan disbursement, improved asset quality, and sound management of third-party funds totaling IDR 193.03 trillion.

In supporting the sustainable finance agenda, Permata Bank recorded significant growth in its Sustainable Business Activities Category (KKUB) financing portfolio. As of the end of 2025, the total KKUB portfolio reached IDR 30.1 trillion, increasing by 33.3% compared to the prior year, with the main contribution coming from Environmentally Friendly Business Activities (KUBL) financing of IDR 24.9 trillion. This portfolio represented 18.49% of the Bank's total loans, up from 14.73% in 2024.

Throughout 2025, KUBL financing focused on sectors that deliver positive environmental impacts, such as renewable energy, pollution prevention and control, sustainable management of biodiversity and land use, environmentally friendly transportation, and green buildings. This strengthening of the green portfolio was supported by electric vehicle financing, environmentally friendly property financing, syndicated financing under sustainability-linked loan mechanisms, and placements in sustainable bond instruments. The Bank also provided MSME financing of IDR 5.2 trillion to expand financial access and support more inclusive economic growth.

Operationally, Permata Bank strengthened environmentally friendly practices through energy efficiency and emissions reduction. The implementation of LED replacement programs, optimization of air-conditioning systems, energy-saving campaigns, and the strengthening of sustainability culture reduced Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions by 4.90% compared to 2024. These efforts form part of the Bank's pathway to achieving Net Zero Emissions (NZE), namely NZE for operational Scope 1 and Scope 2 by 2030, and NZE for financing activities by 2052. In 2025, Permata Bank also obtained two GREENSHIP certifications at GOLD level from Green Building Council Indonesia for the Permata Bank Bintaro Sector 7 building in South Tangerang and the Permata Bank Merdeka building in Bandung. This achievement underscores the Bank's efforts to enhancing green building standards and operational efficiency.

Permata Bank juga mencatat sejumlah capaian dalam hal lingkungan dan sosial sepanjang 2025. Dari sisi kontribusi terhadap lingkungan, Bank mendukung pelestarian keanekaragaman hayati melalui penanaman 5.000 pohon sebagai bagian dari upaya menjaga habitat gajah di kawasan Bukit Tigapuluh, Jambi. Dari aspek sosial, Bank telah menjalankan program literasi keuangan yang menjangkau 6.894 penerima manfaat sepanjang 2025. Selain itu, keterlibatan karyawan melalui program Employee Volunteer (EVO) juga semakin kuat, dengan total 3.720 partisipasi PermataBankers dalam berbagai aktivitas pelestarian lingkungan dan pemberdayaan masyarakat di berbagai wilayah.

Di sisi tata kelola pembiayaan, Permata Bank mengintegrasikan aspek LST secara menyeluruh ke dalam proses bisnis, khususnya dalam persetujuan kredit. Penerapan penilaian risiko lingkungan dan sosial, pemenuhan dokumen lingkungan hidup, serta penggunaan taksonomi keuangan berkelanjutan Indonesia, menjadi dasar pengambilan keputusan pembiayaan, guna memastikan keselarasan antara pertumbuhan portofolio dan pengelolaan risiko keberlanjutan.

Selain itu, Bank terus memperkuat digitalisasi sebagai bagian dari peningkatan layanan perbankan yang terus-menerus. Peningkatan adopsi layanan digital tidak hanya memperluas akses masyarakat terhadap layanan keuangan, tetapi juga berkontribusi pada efisiensi operasional dan pengurangan dampak lingkungan. Hingga akhir 2025, jumlah pengguna layanan digital meningkat sekitar 10%, dengan volume transaksi melalui Permata ME mencapai Rp234 triliun, didukung oleh peningkatan transaksi QRIS sebesar 83% dibandingkan periode tahun lalu.

Penguatan penerapan keuangan berkelanjutan juga tercermin dari pengakuan eksternal yang diterima Perseroan sepanjang periode pelaporan. Pada 2025, Permata Bank memperoleh Peringkat A dalam Studi Laporan Keberlanjutan 2024 yang diselenggarakan oleh Foundation for International Human Rights Reporting Standards (FIHRRST), serta meraih Juara 2 kategori Non-BUMN dan Non-BUMD Go Publik Sektor Keuangan dalam ajang Annual Report Award (ARA) 2024 yang diselenggarakan oleh Komite Nasional Kebijakan Governansi (KNKG). Prestasi ini menjadikan kami untuk lebih meningkatkan kualitas dalam menerapkan keuangan berkelanjutan.

## STRATEGI PENCAPAIAN TARGET

Pada 2025, Permata Bank fokus pada strategi peningkatan kapasitas sumber daya manusia dan pengelolaan portofolio kredit sesuai dengan Rencana Aksi Keuangan Berkelanjutan (RAKB). Target lima tahun yang tertulis dalam RAKB menjadi acuan dalam menjalankan kegiatan keuangan berkelanjutan. Hasil capaian RAKB setiap tahun disampaikan kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan bersama dengan rencana bisnis bank.

Permata Bank also recorded a number of environmental and social achievements throughout 2025. In terms of environmental contribution, the Bank supported biodiversity conservation through the planting of 5,000 trees as part of efforts to preserve elephant habitats in the Bukit Tigapuluh area, Jambi. From a social perspective, the Bank delivered financial literacy programs reaching 6,894 beneficiaries during 2025. In addition, employee engagement through the Employee Volunteer (EVO) program continued to strengthen, with a total of 3,720 participations by PermataBankers in various environmental conservation and community empowerment activities across different regions.

In financing governance, Permata Bank integrates ESG aspects into its business processes, particularly within credit approval. The application of environmental and social risk assessments, fulfillment of environmental documentation requirements, and the use of Indonesia's sustainable finance taxonomy serve as key bases for financing decisions, ensuring alignment between portfolio growth and sustainability risk management.

In addition, the Bank continued to strengthen digitalization as part of ongoing improvements in banking services. Increased adoption of digital services not only expanded public access to financial services but also contributed to operational efficiency and reduced environmental impacts. As of the end of 2025, the number of digital service users increased by around 10%, with transaction volume through Permata ME reaching IDR 234 trillion, supported by an 83% increase in QRIS transactions compared to the previous year.

The strengthening of sustainable finance implementation is also reflected in external recognition received during the reporting period. In 2025, Permata Bank received an A rating in the 2024 Sustainability Report Study conducted by the Foundation for International Human Rights Reporting Standards (FIHRRST), and achieved 2nd place in the Non-SOE and Non-Regional SOE Public Financial Sector category at the Annual Report Award (ARA) 2024 organized by the National Committee on Governance Policy (KNKG). These achievements further motivate the Bank to continue improving the quality of its sustainable finance implementation.

## TARGET ACHIEVEMENT STRATEGY

In 2025, Permata Bank focused on strategies to strengthen human capital capacity and manage the loan portfolio in line with the Sustainable Finance Action Plan (RAKB). The five-year targets set out in the RAKB serve as the reference for implementing sustainable finance activities. Progress against the RAKB is reported annually to the Financial Services Authority together with the Bank's business plan.

Peluang dan prospek usaha perbankan ke depan tetap menjadi salah satu penopang perekonomian nasional. Dinamika yang semakin besar menuntut pengembangan usaha yang lebih cermat, termasuk dalam mendukung sektor-sektor 'Second Nationally Determined Contribution' (SNDC) yang krusial untuk mencapai target emisi nol bersih 2060, yaitu pertanian dan kehutanan (AFOLU), manufaktur/IPPU, pengolahan limbah, konstruksi, dan transportasi. Melalui strategi kerja sama dengan berbagai pihak, perhitungan risiko dan peluang, serta kehatihatan, Permata Bank akan berupaya meningkatkan portofolio di sektor prioritas ini dengan mempertimbangkan faktor eksternal, termasuk perubahan berbagai regulasi dan tekanan pemangku kepentingan.

## APRESIASI

Keberhasilan Permata Bank dalam mengimplementasikan berbagai inisiatif keberlanjutan tidak terlepas dari keterlibatan aktif dan kepercayaan yang diberikan oleh para pemangku kepentingan. Dukungan dari nasabah, mitra usaha, regulator, investor, serta seluruh PermataBankers menjadi fondasi penting dalam menjaga kesinambungan antara kinerja bisnis dan penerapan prinsip LST.

Permata Bank akan terus memanfaatkan sinergi yang terbangun dengan para pemangku kepentingan sebagai penggerak utama dalam memperkuat penerapan keberlanjutan di seluruh lini bisnis. Dengan mengedepankan keseimbangan antara penciptaan nilai ekonomi, pengelolaan risiko, dan dampak sosial lingkungan, Bank memastikan setiap langkah strategis memberikan kontribusi jangka panjang yang bermakna bagi masyarakat dan perekonomian nasional.

Future banking opportunities and business prospects remain key pillars supporting the national economy. Increasing dynamics require more deliberate business development, including support for sectors under the Second Nationally Determined Contribution (SNDC) that are critical to achieving Indonesia's 2060 net zero target, namely agriculture and forestry (AFOLU), manufacturing/IPPU, waste management, construction, and transportation. Through collaboration with various parties, risk and opportunity assessment, and prudence, Permata Bank will seek to increase its portfolio in these priority sectors while considering external factors, including regulatory changes and stakeholder expectations.

## APPRECIATION

Permata Bank's achievements in implementing sustainability initiatives are supported by the active engagement and trust of stakeholders. Support from customers, business partners, regulators, investors, and all PermataBankers remains an essential foundation in maintaining alignment between business performance and ESG implementation.

Permata Bank will continue to leverage stakeholder synergies as a key driver in strengthening sustainability implementation across all business lines. By prioritizing a balance between economic value creation, risk management, and social and environmental impacts, the Bank ensures that each strategic step delivers meaningful long-term contributions to society and the national economy.

# Approach for Determining Material Topics

Permata Bank menerapkan pendekatan materialitas ganda melalui focus group discussion (FGD) yang melibatkan fungsi-fungsisi internal di Perusahaan yang merepresentasikan para pemangku kepentingan. Perusahaan turut melibatkan PIINA eksternal sebagai tim ahli dalam proses asesmen. Asesmen dilakukan melalui beberapa tahapan, yakni:

1. Peninjauan kembali topik material tahun sebelumnya;
2. Identifikasi isu-isu signifikan pada tahun 2025;
3. Penilaian tingkat signifikansi materialitas dampak dan materialitas finansial untuk setiap topik dari skala 1 sampai 4;
4. Penyesuaian kembali terhadap topik material prioritas oleh tim internal Permata Bank.

Pada Laporan Keberlanjutan 2025, terdapat penyesuaian terhadap topik material dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Seluruh topik material yang diungkapkan dalam Laporan ini telah memperoleh persetujuan Direksi.

Permata Bank applies a double materiality assessment (DMA) approach through focus group discussion (FGD) involving relevant internal functions within the Company that represent the stakeholders. The assessment is also attended by external parties acting as expert advisors. The process includes:

1. Review of the previous year's material topics;
2. Identification of significant issues in 2025;
3. Assessment of both impact materiality and financial materiality for each topic in scale of 1 to 4;
4. Readjustment of priority material topics by Permata Bank internal team.

The 2025 Sustainability Report reflects changes to the material topics compared to the previous year. All material topics presented in this Report have been approved by the Board of Directors.

# Strategi Keberlanjutan [A.1][2-22] Sustainability Strategy

Permata Bank mengintegrasikan kepentingan ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan ke dalam aktivitas bisnis dan operasionalnya. Komitmen tersebut selaras dengan visi keberlanjutan Bank, yaitu "Menjadi mitra keuangan terpercaya yang mendorong transformasi menuju ekonomi yang berkelanjutan, inklusif, dan bertanggung jawab." Untuk mendukung visi tersebut, Permata Bank menyusun Rencana Aksi Keuangan Berkelanjutan (RAKB) Periode 2024-2028 yang dirancang gunna memastikan penerapan prinsip lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (LST) di seluruh kegiatan Bank.

Dalam kerangka RAKB 2024-2028, sejumlah program telah dirancang dan sudah berjalan pada 2025. Program-program tersebut, mencakup penguatan pembiayaan berkelanjutan, serta pengembangan produk dan layanan keuangan yang mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi berkelanjutan, baik yang memberikan dampak positif terhadap lingkungan maupun mendorong inklusi sosial. Selain itu, Bank juga memperkuat aspek tata kelola melalui pengelolaan risiko terkait perubahan iklim, upaya pencapaian Net Zero Emission (NZE) dari operasional Bank, pengembangan proses pengadaan berkelanjutan, pelaksanaan Sustainability Learning Series, penguatan Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).

Melalui implementasi RAKB tersebut, Permata Bank berupaya memberikan kontribusi positif bagi lingkungan dan masyarakat, antara lain dengan mendukung transisi menuju masa depan rendah karbon, menjaga keanekaragaman hayati, serta meningkatkan literasi keuangan di masyarakat. Di sisi internal, Bank juga memastikan terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang bertanggung jawab dan kondusif bagi PermataBankers dengan menerapkan budaya keberlanjutan dan menjunjung tinggi etika bisnis.

Permata Bank integrates economic, social, and environmental considerations into its business and operational activities. This commitment is aligned with the Bank's sustainability vision, namely "To become a trusted financial partner that drives transformation towards a sustainable, inclusive, and responsible economy." To support this vision, Permata Bank has developed a Sustainable Finance Action Plan (RAKB) for the 2024-2028 period, which is designed to ensure the implementation of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles across all of the Bank's activities.

Within the framework of the 2024-2028 Sustainable Finance Action Plan (RAKB), a number of programs were designed and have been implemented in 2025. These programs include the strengthening of sustainable financing, as well as the development of financial products and services that support sustainable economic growth, both by generating positive environmental impacts and by promoting social inclusion. In addition, the Bank has strengthened governance aspects through the management of climate change-related risks, efforts to achieve Net Zero Emissions (NZE) from the Bank's operations, the development of sustainable procurement processes, the implementation of the Sustainability Learning Series, the strengthening of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).

Through the implementation of the Sustainable Finance Action Plan (RAKB), Permata Bank seeks to make a positive contribution to the environment and society, including by supporting the transition towards a low-carbon future, preserving biodiversity balance, and enhancing financial literacy within the community. Internally, the Bank also ensures the creation of a responsible and conducive working environment for PermataBankers by embedding a culture of sustainability and upholding high standards of business ethics.

# Membangun Budaya Keberlanjutan [F.1]

# Establishing a Sustainability Culture

![img-51.jpeg](img-51.jpeg)

Permata Bank menjadikan visi serta nilai utama I-PRICE sebagai fondasi bagi PermataBankers dalam bekerja, berinteraksi, dan berperilaku. Nilai-nilai tersebut juga menjadi rujukan dalam penguatan budaya keberlanjutan di lingkungan internal Bank. Permata Bank mendorong partisipasi aktif karyawan dalam pengembangan budaya keberlanjutan melalui berbagai kampanye di media digital dan seminar internal, serta program Sustainability Culture yang berfokus pada integrasi nilai keberlanjutan di dalam proses kerja dan gaya hidup sehari-hari karyawan.

Melalui program Sustainability Culture, dibentuk Culture Network yang terdiri dari Culture Champions, Culture Leaders, dan Culture Agents dari setiap perwakilan Direktorat. Di tahun 2025, Culture Network telah mengembangkan 96 program keberlanjutan. Program-program tersebut dijalankan di tingkat Divisi dan dimonitor oleh Culture Champions di masing-masing Direktorat. Untuk memastikan programnya berjalan dengan baik, Divisi Sustainability telah menyelenggarakan 9 Sustainability Culture Workshop bagi seluruh anggota Culture Network sepanjang 2025.

Di akhir periode program, Divisi Sustainability melalui Sustainability Committee Meeting melakukan penilaian terhadap program-program yang memiliki dampak terukur serta relevan dengan komitmen keberlanjutan Permata Bank. Sebagai bentuk apresiasi, Permata Bank memberikan penghargaan kepada Divisi dan Culture Network dengan program terbaik, yang diumumkan melalui Culture Awards Permata Bank.

Selain itu, PermataBankers turut dilibatkan dalam program Employee Volunteers (EVO) sebagai sarana untuk menciptakan dampak positif bagi masyarakat sekaligus menumbuhkan sense of purpose bagi karyawan dalam berkarya dan berkontribusi secara nyata.

Upaya peningkatan kesadaran terhadap 'Sustainability Journey Permata Bank' juga dilakukan melalui pengiriman e-mail blast secara berkala kepada seluruh karyawan, termasuk Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris. Komunikasi internal tersebut memuat poster serta informasi singkat mengenai berbagai inisiatif keberlanjutan yang dijalankan, dengan mengusung tagar #SayangiBumi dan #DenganHati. Sepanjang tahun 2025, Bank melakukan pengiriman 39 e-mail blast Sustainability Journey kepada seluruh karyawan.

![img-52.jpeg](img-52.jpeg)

Permata Bank adopts its vision and core I-PRICE values as the foundation for PermataBankers in working, interacting, and conducting themselves. These values also serve as a reference for strengthening a culture of sustainability within the Bank's internal environment. Permata Bank encourages active employee participation in the development of a sustainability culture through various digital media campaigns, internal seminars, and Sustainability Culture Program that focus on integrating sustainability values into work processes and employees' everyday lifestyles.

Through the Sustainability Culture program, a Culture Network was established, consisting of Culture Champions, Culture Leaders, and Culture Agents from each Directorate. By 2025, the Culture Network had developed 96 sustainability programs. These programs are implemented at the Division level and monitored by Culture Champions in each Directorate. To ensure the program's success, the Sustainability Division held 9 Sustainability Culture Workshops for all Culture Network members throughout 2025.

At the end of the program period, the Sustainability Division, through a Sustainability Committee Meeting, assessed programs that had a measurable impact and were relevant to Permata Bank's sustainability commitments. As a token of appreciation, Permata Bank presented awards to the Divisions and Culture Networks with the best programs, which were announced through the Permata Bank Culture Awards.

In addition, PermataBankers are involved in the Employee Volunteers (EVO) program as a means of creating positive social impact while fostering a sense of purpose among employees in their work and in making tangible contributions.

Efforts to enhance awareness of 'Permata Bank's Sustainability Journey' are also undertaken through the periodic distribution of email blasts to all employees, including the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners. These internal communications feature posters and brief information on various sustainability initiatives implemented by the Bank, using the hashtags #SayangiBumi and #DenganHati. Throughout 2025, the Bank carried out 39 e-mail blast update on sustainability journey activities.

# PERBANDINGAN ANTARA TARGET DAN REALISASI TAHUN 2025 [F.2]

Permata Bank menutup tahun 2025 dengan kinerja yang solid, di mana sebagian besar indikator keuangan utama mencapai target yang telah ditetapkan serta mencatat pertumbuhan positif jika dibandingkan tahun sebelumnya. Hingga akhir Desember 2025, total aset Bank mencapai Rp268,34 triliun, tumbuh 4,0% (yoy), namun sedikit di bawah target RBB sebesar Rp272,38 triliun. Peningkatan aset ini didorong oleh pertumbuhan kredit sebesar 5,0% (yoy) menjadi Rp163,34 triliun. Sementara itu, nilai ekuitas pada akhir tahun 2025 tercatat Rp45,85 triliun, atau 101,0% dari target RBB sebesar Rp45,36 triliun. Penguatan ekuitas ini sejalan dengan peningkatan profitabilitas yang lebih baik sepanjang tahun 2025.

Di tengah ketidakpastian kondisi makroekonomi yang berdampak pada daya beli masyarakat, Permata Bank tetap mampu mencatat pertumbuhan positif dalam penyaluran kredit, mencerminkan peran intermediasi yang dijalankan secara konsisten. Hingga akhir 2025, kredit tumbuh 5,0% (yoy), didorong oleh peningkatan pada segmen Corporate sebesar 11,0% (yoy) dan Commercial sebesar 2,0% (yoy). Keberhasilan ini disertai dengan pengelolaan portofolio yang sehat, tercermin dari rasio NPL bruto dan NPL neto masing-masing 2,1% dan 0,2%, lebih baik jika dibandingkan target RBB sebesar 2,3% dan 0,4%.

Terkait aktivitas penghimpunan dana, Permata Bank berhasil mengelola Dana Pihak Ketiga (DPK) secara optimal. Hingga akhir tahun 2025, DPK tercatat sebesar Rp192,82 triliun, tumbuh 4,0% (yoy). Meskipun sedikit di bawah target RBB, pencapaian ini sejalan dengan strategi Bank untuk menjaga rasio Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR) pada tingkat optimal 85,0%, guna memastikan likuiditas yang sehat sekaligus memberikan return yang lebih optimal bagi Bank sepanjang tahun. Seiring dengan pertumbuhan DPK, rasio dana murah (CASA) juga terjaga di level sehat sebesar 64,0%. Pencapaian ini mencerminkan efektivitas strategi manajemen likuiditas dan pendanaan Permata Bank yang berfokus pada sumber dana murah dan berkesinambungan.

Dalam hal profitabilitas, pendapatan bunga Permata Bank sepanjang 2025 tercatat sebesar Rp10,02 triliun, atau sesuai dengan target RBB. Pencapaian ini terutama didorong oleh pertumbuhan kredit yang sehat serta optimalisasi aset produktif. Sejalan dengan kinerja pendapatan yang positif, laba operasional Bank mencapai Rp4,62 triliun, 1,0% di atas target RBB yang didukung oleh peningkatan pendapatan operasional Bank.

Seiring dengan kemampuan Bank mencetak laba, sejumlah rasio keuangan utama Permata Bank menunjukkan kinerja solid. Rasio NIM tercatat 4,0%, ROA 1,7%, CIR 49,6% dan BOPO 76,6%, selaras dengan target RBB yang ditetapkan. Hal ini mencerminkan efektivitas pengelolaan aset sepanjang tahun. Sementara itu, rasio ROE sebesar 6,8% sedikit di bawah target RBB 7,0%.

# COMPARISON BETWEEN TARGETS AND REALIZATIONS FOR 2025 [F.2]

Permata Bank ended 2025 with strong results, as most key financial indicators exceeded targets and delivered positive growth compared to the previous year. By the end of December 2025, total assets reached IDR 268.34 trillion, representing 4.0% YoY growth, although slightly below the RBB target of IDR 272.38 trillion. This growth was primarily supported by 5.0% YoY increase in loans, reaching IDR 163.34 trillion. Meanwhile, equity strengthened to IDR 45.85 trillion, exceeding the RBB target of IDR 45.36 trillion at 101.0%. The improvement in equity reflects the Bank's enhanced profitability throughout the year.

Despite macroeconomic uncertainty impacting consumer purchasing power, Permata Bank successfully maintained positive loan growth, reaffirming its consistent role as a financial intermediary. By the end of 2025, total loans increased by 5.0% YoY, driven by 11.0% YoY growth in Corporate segment and 2.0% YoY growth in Commercial segment. This achievement was accompanied by prudent portfolio management, as reflected in gross and net NPL ratios of 2.1% and 0.2%, respectively—both better than the RBB targets of 2.3% and 0.4%.

In funding activities, Permata Bank effectively optimized the management of Third-Party Funds (TPF). By year-end 2025, TPF reached IDR 192.82 trillion, reflecting 4.0% YoY growth. Although slightly below the RBB target, this achievement aligns with the Bank's strategy to maintain an optimal Loan-to-Deposit Ratio (LDR) of 85.0%, ensuring robust liquidity while delivering sustainable returns throughout the year. In line with TPF growth, the CASA ratio remained robust at 64.0%, reaffirming the strength of Permata Bank's liquidity and funding strategy, which focuses on sustainable, low-cost sources of funds.

In terms of profitability, Permata Bank recorded interest income of IDR 10.02 trillion in 2025, or inline with the RBB target. This performance was primarily driven by prudent loan growth and the effective optimization of productive assets. In line with strong revenue results, operating profit reached IDR 4.62 trillion, 1.0% above the RBB target driven by higher operating income.

Alongside the Bank's strong profitability, key financial ratios reflected solid performance. The NIM stood at 4.0%, ROA at 1.7%, CIR at 49.6%, and BOPO at 76.6%, all in line with the RBB targets, reflecting effective asset management throughout the year. Meanwhile, ROE was recorded at 6.8%, slightly below the RBB target of 7.0%.

Permata Bank mengembangkan dan melaksanakan sejumlah inisiatif yang terintegrasi dalam kegiatan bisnis dan operasional, antara lain:

4. Integrasi aspek LST pada Bisnis

[FN-CB-410a.2][FN-CB-550a.2]

Permata Bank menerapkan prinsip lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (LST) sebagai bagian integral dari proses persetujuan kredit yang diatur dalam Kebijakan Perkreditan dan Kebijakan Khusus Pembiayaan Berkelanjutan. Nasabah pada sektor dengan tingkat risiko lingkungan dan sosial tertentu diwajibkan memenuhi ketentuan peraturan yang berlaku serta menjalani Penilaian Kebutuhan Lingkungan dan Sosial (Environment and Social Requirement Assessment/ESRA), dengan pendekatan penilaian yang disesuaikan berdasarkan karakteristik sektor usaha. Pemenuhan ESRA menjadi salah satu dasar utama dalam pengambilan keputusan kredit, dan kebijakan terkait dirinya secara berkala untuk memastikan kesesuaiannya dengan perkembangan regulasi keuangan berkelanjutan.

Dalam implementasinya, Bank mensyaratkan kelengkapan dokumen lingkungan hidup seperti AMDAL/UKL/UPL dan PROPER sejak tahap inisiasi hingga kajian tahunan kredit. Nasabah yang tidak memenuhi persyaratan atau memiliki peringkat PROPER merah atau hitam dikategorikan sebagai berisiko tinggi. Penilaian juga mencakup telaah atas kinerja keberlanjutan debitur apabila informasi tersebut tersedia.

4. Integration of ESG Aspects into Business Activities

[FN-CB-410a.2][FN-CB-550a.2]

Permata Bank applies environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles as an integral part of its credit approval process, as stipulated in the Credit Policy and the Sustainable Financing Special Policy. Customers operating in sectors with certain levels of environmental and social risk are required to comply with applicable regulations and to undergo an Environmental and Social Requirement Assessment (ESRA), with the assessment approach tailored to the characteristics of each business sector. Compliance with ESRA constitutes one of the key bases for credit decision-making, and the related policies are reviewed periodically to ensure alignment with developments in sustainable finance regulations.

In its implementation, the Bank requires the completeness of environmental documentation, such as Environmental Impact Assessments (AMDAL), Environmental Management and Monitoring Efforts (UKL/UPL), and PROPER ratings, from the initiation stage through to the annual credit review. Customers that fail to meet these requirements or hold red or black PROPER ratings are categorised as high risk. The assessment also includes a review of the debtor's sustainability performance, where such information is available.

3. Risiko yang berkaitan dengan masalah lingkungan dan sosial dikenali, dievaluasi, dan jika relevan, dimitigasi secara lebih baik.

Proses identifikasi terhadap implementasi keuangan berkelanjutan dan analisa ESRA dilakukan bersamaan pada saat pengajuan proposal kredit yang diinformasikan melalui media Proposal Kredit.

Saat ini Permata Bank mengatur empat parameter untuk identifikasi keuangan berkelanjutan (selain ESRA) yang wajib dianalisa dan dituangkan dalam proposal kredit oleh unit bisnis sesuai karakteristik usaha debitur. Pengisian informasi atas parameter tersebut harus mencakup Kode Klasifikasi dan Deskripsi yang sesuai dengan kode. Adapun empat parameter tersebut meliputi: Sektor ekonomi KBLI level 5, Klasifikasi TKBI, Klasifikasi KUBL, dan Klasifikasi Thematic.

Analisa ini selalu diperbaharui sesuai dengan kondisi debitur ter-update, umumnya pembaharan data dilakukan pada saat proses perpanjangan fasilitas, pada proses perpanjangan fasilitas, RM harus memastikan kesesuaian seluruh informasi terkait dengan telah analisa pembiayaan berkelanjutan dengan informasi yang ada di dalam system.

Untuk mendukung efektivitas pengelolaan risiko, Permata Bank memanfaatkan teknologi digital dalam pengumpulan dan analisis data nasabah gunna memastikan kesesuaian dengan kebijakan risiko LST. Selain itu, Bank menerapkan Taksonomi Hijau Indonesia (THI) dan Taksonomi Keuangan Berkelanjutan Indonesia (TKBI) untuk mengidentifikasi portofolio pembiayaan berkelanjutan serta memantau debitur dengan risiko lingkungan dan sosial yang tinggi, sehingga penyaluran kredit tetap selaras dengan prinsip keuangan berkelanjutan yang ditetapkan oleh OJK.

The Bank recognizes that its primary environmental and social impacts may arise through credit decisions. Accordingly, the Bank requires the following:

1. All credit proposals must include consideration of environmental and social issues where relevant.
2. All credit applications must take into account applicable environmental and social standards, both internationally and under prevailing laws and regulations in Indonesia.
3. Risks related to environmental and social issues are identified, assessed, and, where relevant, mitigated.

The identification process for sustainable finance implementation and the ESRA analysis are conducted in parallel at the time of submitting the Credit Facility Request (CFR), as documented in the Credit Proposal.

Permata Bank currently applies four parameters for sustainable finance identification (in addition to ESRA) that must be analyzed and documented in the credit proposal by the business unit, based on the debtor's business characteristics. Completion of these parameters must include the relevant classification code and the corresponding description. The four parameters are: KBLI economic sector (Level 5), TKBI Classification, KUBL Classification, and Thematic Classification.

This analysis is updated to reflect the debtor's latest conditions. Updates are generally conducted during facility renewal processes, where the RM is required to ensure that all sustainable financing analysis information is consistent with the data recorded in the system.

To support the effectiveness of risk management, Permata Bank leverages digital technology in the collection and analysis of customer data to ensure compliance with ESG risk policies. In addition, the Bank applies the Indonesian Green Taxonomy (Taksonomi Hijau Indonesia/THI) and the Indonesian Sustainable Finance Taxonomy (Taksonomi Keuangan Berkelanjutan Indonesia/TKBI) to identify sustainable financing portfolios and to monitor debtors with high environmental and social risks, thereby ensuring that credit disbursement remains aligned with the sustainable finance principles stipulated by the Financial Services Authority.

# Pengendalian Dampak Lingkungan Environmental Impact Management

Meskipun kegiatan perbankan tidak secara langsung menimbulkan dampak lingkungan yang signifikan, aktivitas operasional sehari-hari tetap memiliki potensi dampak, seperti penggunaan energi, konsumsi kertas, dan pengelolaan limbah. Selain itu, keputusan pembiayaan yang diambil Bank juga dapat menimbulkan dampak lingkungan secara tidak langsung, khususnya apabila pembiayaan disalurkan kepada sektor atau proyek dengan tingkat risiko lingkungan yang tinggi.

Dari hasil pilot bottom-up Climate Risk Management & Scenario Analysis (CRMS) tahun 2025, Permata Bank mengidentifikasi dampak dari risiko iklim terhadap pembiayaan. Dalam jangka panjang, pembiayaan pada sektor intensif karbon berpotensi mendorong peningkatan NPL, ATMR, dan CKPN karena sektor tersebut paling rentan terhadap risiko transisi, serta berkontribusi besar terhadap emisi Bank dari aktivitas pembiayaan. Perburukan kualitas kredit terbesar diproyeksikan terjadi pada sektor pertambangan batubara, perkebunan & kelapa sawit, serta sektor pengolahan.

Hasil Kajian CRMS dipresentasikan dan disosialisasikan kepada manajemen senior, unit bisnis, dan unit terkait lainnya untuk membangun kesadaran terkait risiko iklim walaupun belum menjadi acuan dalam menentukan strategi bisnis. Saat ini Bank fokus pada peningkatan kualitas data terkait risiko iklim, penguatan metodologi pengukuran, serta peningkatan kemampuan SDM sehingga hasil Kajian dan pengukuran lebih kredibel dan dapat digunakan untuk tujuan yang lebih luas.

Dari sisi operasional, Permata Bank mengintegrasikan prinsip pelestarian lingkungan dalam kebijakan operasional dan mendorong penerapan budaya keberlanjutan di seluruh aktivitas internal Bank.

Sebagai bagian dari upaya tersebut, di tahun 2025 Permata Bank melakukan:

1. Kampanye hemat energi melalui berbagai platform internal Bank (e-mail blast, Permata Portal/News, media sosial internal, digital signage).
2. Penggantian lampu ke lampu LED yang lebih hemat energi sebanyak kurang lebih 1.200 pcs.
3. Penggantian kendaraan Dewan Direksi menjadi EV.
4. Penyesuaian waktu nyala peralatan listrik (AC, lift, lampu) lebih lambat 30 menit di Gedung Bintaro Sektor 7 Tangerang.
5. Sertifikasi green building untuk Gedung Bintaro Sektor 7 Tangerang Selatan dan Gedung Merdeka Bandung.

Although banking activities do not directly cause significant environmental impacts, day-to-day operations still have potential impacts, including energy use, paper consumption, and waste management. In addition, the Bank's financing decisions may also create indirect environmental impacts, particularly where financing is extended to sectors or projects with higher environmental risk profiles.

Based on the 2025 bottom-up Climate Risk Management & Scenario Analysis (CRMS) pilot, Permata Bank identified the impacts of climate risk on its financing activities. Over the long term, financing exposure to carbon-intensive sectors may contribute to higher NPLs, RWA, and ECL allowances, as these sectors are the most vulnerable to transition risks and are significant contributors to the Bank's financed emissions. The most significant deterioration in credit quality is projected to occur in the coal mining sector, the plantation and palm oil sector, and the manufacturing sector.

The CRMS assessment results were presented and socialized to senior management, business units, and other relevant units to build awareness of climate risks, although they have not yet been used as a primary reference in determining business strategy. The Bank is currently focused on improving climate risk-related data quality, strengthening measurement methodologies, and enhancing human resource capabilities so that assessment and measurement results are more credible and can be applied for broader purposes.

From an operational perspective, Permata Bank integrates environmental conservation principles into its operational policies and promotes the adoption of a sustainability culture across the Bank's internal activities.

As part of these efforts, in 2025 Permata Bank:

1. Conducted energy conservation campaigns through various internal platforms (e-mail blasts, Permata Portal/News, internal social media, and digital signage).
2. Replaced approximately 1,200 lights with more energy-efficient LED lights.
3. Replaced Board of Directors' vehicles with EVs.
4. Adjustment of electrical equipment start times (AC, elevators, and lights) by 30 minutes in the Bintaro Sector 7 Building, Tangerang.
5. Green building certification for the Bintaro Sector 7 Building in South Tangerang and the Merdeka Building in Bandung.

# Pengelolaan Air dan Efluen
## Water and Effluent Management

Pemantauan konsumsi air di lingkungan Permata Bank dilakukan dengan mengonsolidasikan data penggunaan dari 12 kantor utama yang tersebar di berbagai wilayah, termasuk Jakarta, Tangerang Selatan, Medan, Palembang, Bandung, Surabaya, dan Makassar. Pendekatan ini digunakan untuk memperoleh gambaran menyeluruh atas pola pemanfaatan air serta menjadi dasar evaluasi efektivitas pengelolaan air di seluruh operasional Bank. Berdasarkan hasil evaluasi di tahun 2025, pemakaian air di 12 kantor utama mengalami penurunan sebesar 0.5% dibandingkan dengan tahun 2024. Data penggunaan air dihitung dari pemakaian yang berasal dari PAM dan perusahaan air lokal. Pada tahun 2025, Permata Bank juga telah berhasil mengkonsolidasikan data konsumsi air di 105 gedung lainnya, sehingga total terdapat 117 gedung yang konsumsi air nya telah dikonsolidasi.

Dalam menjalankan kegiatan operasional, kebutuhan air Bank dipenuhi melalui pasokan perusahaan penyedia air dan pemanfaatan air tanah. Untuk menjaga kualitas air tanah dan memastikan pengelolaan air limbah yang bertanggung jawab, Bank menerapkan berbagai sarana pendukung, seperti pembangunan sumur resapan, penggunaan Instalasi Pengolahan Air Limbah (IPAL)/Sistem Pengolahan Air Limbah (STP), serta pemanfaatan bioseptic tank di kantor pusat dan cabang. Seluruh sistem tersebut didukung dengan perawatan berkala terhadap saluran pembuangan air limbah. [F.14][303-1][303-2][303-4]

Selain itu, upaya efisiensi konsumsi air juga dilakukan melalui penerapan teknologi dan inisiatif internal. Bank telah memasang keran otomatis di 3 kantor utama dan cabang Merdeka Bandung serta mengoperasikan instalasi daur ulang air limbah (water recycle) di Kantor Bintaro Sektor 7 Tangerang Selatan untuk pemanfaatan kembali air pada penyiraman taman. Instalasi daur ulang air limbah (water recycle) ini menghemat 257 m³ pada tahun 2025 untuk kebutuhan penyiraman taman. Upaya teknis ini dilengkapi dengan kampanye penghematan air kepada seluruh PermataBankers melalui e-mail blast Sustainability Journey guna mendorong perubahan perilaku yang lebih berkelanjutan. [303-1]

Water consumption monitoring at Permata Bank is carried out by consolidating usage data from 12 main offices across multiple locations, including Jakarta, South Tangerang, Medan, Palembang, Bandung, Surabaya, and Makassar. This approach provides a comprehensive view of water use patterns and serves as the basis for evaluating the effectiveness of water management across the Bank's operations. Based on the 2025 evaluation, water consumption across the 12 main offices decreased by 0.5% compared to 2024. Water usage data is calculated based on consumption sourced from the municipal water utility (PAM) and local water companies. In 2025, Permata Bank also successfully consolidated water consumption data from an additional 105 buildings, bringing the total to 117 buildings with consolidated water consumption data.

In its operations, the Bank's water needs are met through supplies from water service providers and the use of groundwater. To maintain groundwater quality and ensure responsible wastewater management, the Bank implements supporting measures such as the construction of infiltration wells, the use of wastewater treatment facilities (IPAL)/sewage treatment plants (STP), and the use of bioseptic tanks at the head office and branches. These systems are supported by regular maintenance of wastewater drainage channels. [F.14][303-1][303-2][303-4]

In addition, the Bank also improves water efficiency through the application of technology and internal initiatives. The Bank installed automatic faucets at 3 main offices and at the Merdeka Bandung branch, and operated a wastewater recycling installation at the Bintaro Sector 7 Office in South Tangerang to reuse water for garden irrigation. This wastewater recycling installation saved 257 m³ in 2025 for garden irrigation needs. These technical efforts were complemented by water-saving campaigns delivered to all PermataBankers through Sustainability Journey email blasts to encourage more sustainable behavior. [303-1]

# Pengelolaan Limbah [306-1][306-2]

Waste Management

Secara operasional, limbah yang dihasilkan Permata Bank terdiri atas limbah B3 dan non-B3. Limbah B3 meliputi tinta cartridge, sedangkan limbah non-B3 berasal dari aktivitas perkantoran dan domestik, seperti sampah umum, boks arsip yang dihancurkan, limbah cair, dan limbah kartu. Pengelolaan kedua jenis limbah tersebut dilaksanakan oleh pihak ketiga yang ditunjuk oleh pengelola gedung sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

Berbagai inisiatif telah dilakukan untuk mengurangi jumlah limbah kartu di Permata Bank diantaranya:

1. WhatsApp blast notifikasi kartu yang dikembalikan.
2. Memperbaiki masalah bug pada alamat sehingga meminimalisir alamat pengiriman yang kosong dan undefined pada debit card.
3. Penambahan fitur request card pada Permata ME dengan alamat pengiriman dapat di edit oleh nasabah.
4. Optimalisasi penggunakan Web Call Engine.
5. Jenis kartu Priority & Preferred diinfokan ke Cab untuk ditindaklanjuti.
6. Kartu Kredit staff yang di kembalikan diinformasikan melalui email.
7. Melakukan proses trade-in atau penggantian mesin ATM lama.
8. Melakukan pemetaan dan analisis data gangguan kartu tertelan.
9. Melakukan pemeliharaan preventif secara berkala terhadap card reader.
10. Mengurangi kebutuhan cetak ulang kartu nasabah.

Pada 2025, Bank melanjutkan implementasi program pemilahan sampah di Gedung WTC II, Bintaro dan Hayam Wuruk. Pemisahan sampah organik dan non-organik dilakukan dengan menyediakan dua jenis tempat sampah di setiap lantai, sebagai upaya meningkatkan kesadaran karyawan terhadap pengelolaan sampah sejak sumbernya serta mendukung terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang lebih nyaman dan tertata. [F.14]

Sepanjang tahun 2025, Permata Bank tidak mencatat adanya insiden tumpahan limbah ke lingkungan maupun pengaduan dari masyarakat dan pemangku kepentingan terkait dampak lingkungan. Sehubungan dengan pengelolaan limbah yang seluruhnya dilakukan oleh pihak ketiga melalui pengelola gedung, Bank belum memiliki data kuantitatif mengenai jumlah limbah yang dihasilkan. [F.15]

Operationally, waste generated by Permata Bank consists of hazardous (B3) and non-hazardous (non-B3) waste. Hazardous waste includes ink cartridges, while non-hazardous waste originates from office and domestic activities, such as general waste, destroyed archive boxes, wastewater, and card waste. The management of both waste types is carried out by third parties appointed by building management in accordance with applicable requirements.

Permata Bank implemented various initiatives to reduce card waste, including:

1. WhatsApp blast notifications for returned cards.
2. Fixing address bugs to minimize blank and undefined delivery addresses for debit cards.
3. Adding a card request feature in Permata ME that allows customers to edit the delivery address.
4. Optimizing the use of the Web Call Engine.
5. Informing branches of Priority and Preferred card types for follow-up.
6. Notifying returned staff credit cards via email.
7. Conducting trade-in or replacement of older ATM machines.
8. Mapping and analyzing data on swallowed card disruptions.
9. Conducting periodic preventive maintenance for card readers.
10. Reducing the need for customer card reprints.

In 2025, the Bank continued implementing its waste segregation program at the WTC II, Bintaro, and Hayam Wuruk buildings. Organic and non-organic waste is separated by providing two types of bins on each floor, as an effort to increase employee awareness of waste management at the source and to support a more comfortable and organized workplace. [F.14]

Throughout 2025, Permata Bank did not record any incidents of waste spills into the environment, nor any complaints from the community or stakeholders related to environmental impacts. As waste management is fully handled by third parties through building management, the Bank does not yet have quantitative data on the volume of waste generated. [F.15]

# Pengelolaan Energi dan Emisi

Energy and Emissions Management

Sumber energi yang digunakan dalam operasional Permata Bank berasal dari pasokan listrik PLN serta bahan bakar minyak (BBM) untuk mendukung aktivitas pendukung tertentu. Perhitungan emisi gas rumah kaca (GRK) cakupan 1 dilakukan dengan berpedoman pada metodologi Greenhouse Gas Protocol (GHG) dengan menggunakan faktor emisi dari OJK. Dalam practiknya, perhitungan ini mencakup emisi dari penggunaan kendaraan operasional dan pengoperasian genset, yang dihitung melalui konversi data biaya menjadi volume bahan bakar berdasarkan jenis BBM, jarak tempuh, serta durasi penggunaan, dengan penyesuaian pada masing-masing cost center.

Perhitungan emisi GRK cakupan 2 dilakukan dengan menggunakan faktor emisi dari Data Emisi GRK Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) Tahun 2021. Emisi cakupan 2 berdasar dari penggunaan listrik PLN dari 194 gedung, yang dihitung melalui data-data tagihan listrik yang dikonversi menjadi data dengan satuan kWh.

Di luar cakupan tersebut, Bank juga menghitung emisi GRK cakupan 3 operasional yang bersumber dari aktivitas perjalanan dinas. Emisi dari penggunaan transportasi umum seperti taksi online, kereta api, dan pesawat udara dihitung dengan mengalikan data penggunaan dengan faktor emisi dari regulator. Untuk perjalanan udara, perhitungan dilengkapi dengan penggunaan Carbon Emission Calculator milik ICAO guna memperoleh estimasi emisi yang lebih representatif.

Untuk emisi GRK cakupan 3 dari aktivitas pembiayaan (Financed Emission), perhitungan masih sebatas pemenuhan pelaporan pilot bottom-up Climate Risk Management & Scenario Analysis (CRMS) kepada OJK. Bank belum memiliki data emisi dari debitur sehingga perhitungan dilakukan menggunakan data perantara/proxy yang direfleksikan kepada debitur. Emisi dari aktivitas pembiayaan yang dihitung langsung dari emisi debitur hanya dilakukan terhadap 10 debitur pada segmen korporasi yang diambil dari Laporan Keberlanjutan. Saat ini Bank fokus untuk meningkatkan kualitas data dan pengembangan metodologi perhitungan, serta peningkatan kemampuan SDM. Selain itu Bank juga sedang mempersiapkan prosedur perhitungan emisi dari aktivitas pembiayaan.

Selain itu, belum terdapat penghitungan atas emisi zat perusak ozon maupun emisi non-GRK signifikan lainnya. [305-6][305-7] [FN-CB-410b.4]

Energy used in Permata Bank's operations is sourced from PLN electricity supply and fuel (BBM) to support certain auxiliary activities. Scope 1 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions are calculated in accordance with the Greenhouse Gas Protocol (GHG Protocol) methodology, using emission factors provided by Financial Services Authority. In practice, this calculation includes emissions from the use of operational vehicles and generator sets, estimated by converting cost data into fuel volumes based on fuel type, travel distance, and operating duration, with adjustments applied by each cost center.

Scope 2 GHG emissions are calculated using emission factors from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources 2021 GHG Emissions Data. Scope 2 emissions are derived from PLN electricity consumption across 194 buildings, calculated based on electricity bills converted into kWh.

Beyond these scopes, the Bank also calculates operational Scope 3 GHG emissions arising from business travel activities. Emissions from the use of public transportation such as ride-hailing taxis, trains, and air travel are calculated by multiplying emission factors from regulator. For air travel, the calculation is supplemented by ICAO's Carbon Emissions Calculator to obtain a more representative emissions estimate.

For Scope 3 GHG financed emissions, the calculation is currently limited to meeting the reporting requirements of the bottom-up CRMS pilot submission to Financial Services Authority. The Bank does not yet have emissions data from borrowers, and therefore uses intermediary/proxy data applied to debtors. Financed emissions calculated directly from debtor emissions are only conducted for 10 debtors from corporate segment based on information disclosed in their Sustainability Reports. The Bank is currently focused on improving data quality, developing calculation methodologies, and strengthening human resource capabilities. In addition, the Bank is preparing procedures for calculating emissions from financing activities.

The Bank has not yet calculated ozone-depleting substance emissions or other significant non-GHG emissions. [305-6][305-7] [FN-CB-410b.4]

Peduli terhadap Alam Caring for Nature

Bank menetapkan tahun 2024 sebagai tahun dasar pengukuran emisi guna menjadi rujukan dalam perencanaan program penurunan emisi. Berangkat dari baseline tersebut, Bank merancang sasaran pengurangan energi dan emisi pada kegiatan operasional internal serta aktivitas debitur. Pada tahun 2025, Bank menerapkan inisiatif-inisiatif penurunan emisi, seperti penggantian lampu LED, pengaturan AC, kampanye hemat energi, dan sosialisasi budaya keberlanjutan, sehingga penurunan emisi scope 1 dan scope 2 di 2025 mencapai  $4,90\%$ . [302-5]

Ke depan, upaya penurunan emisi akan terus dilakukan melalui inisiatif-inisiatif internal (termasuk dalam identifikasi sumber emisi utama), maupun skema carbon credit dan pembelian REC. Insisiatif-insiatif ini dilakukan untuk mencapai target Net Zero Emission (NZE) jangka menengah yaitu Net Zero Cakupan 1 & 2 dari aktivitas operasional pada 2030, dan untuk jangka panjang mencapai NZE dari aktivitas pembiayaan pada 2052. Bank saat ini sedang menyusun peta jalan dari NZE sebagai bagian dari strategi jangka menengah untuk menurunkan emisi operasional.

Bank set 2024 as the emissions measurement baseline year to serve as a reference for planning emissions reduction programs. Building on this baseline, the Bank designs energy and emissions reduction targets covering internal operational activities as well as debtors' activities. In 2025, the Bank implemented emissions reduction initiatives, such as replacing lights with LED, optimizing air-conditioning settings, conducting energy-saving campaigns, and socializing a sustainability culture, resulting in a  $4.90\%$  reduction in scope 1 and scope 2 emissions in 2025. [302-5]

Going forward, emissions reduction efforts will continue through internal initiatives (including the identification of key emissions sources), as well as through carbon credit schemes and the purchase of RECs. The Bank will also continue to strengthen sustainable operational practices. These efforts support the achievement of Permata Bank's medium-term NZE targets, namely Net Zero for Scope 1 and Scope 2 operational emissions by 2030, and its long-term target of achieving Net Zero Emissions from financing activities by 2052. The bank is currently developing a roadmap for NZE as part of its medium-term strategy to reduce operational emissions.

# KESETARAAN DAN KEBERAGAMAN KARYAWAN [F.18]

Permata Bank meyakini bahwa keberagaman latar belakang karyawan memperkaya sudut pandang dan meningkatkan kapasitas inovasi, yang pada akhirnya mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis. Sejalan dengan hal tersebut, Bank menerapkan prinsip keberagaman dan inklusivitas tanpa diskriminasi berdasarkan agama, ras, dan gender, serta mendorong keterwakilan lintas usia di tempat kerja. Komitmen terhadap keberagaman tercermin dalam penerapan prinsip keadilan gender yang terintegrasi dalam Kode Etik Karyawan dan Kebijakan Persamaan Harkat dan Martabat dalam Lingkungan Bekerja. Bank juga menjamin perlindungan hak pengidap HIV/AIDS melalui prosedur HIV/AIDS yang mengatur penanganan keadaan darurat, pencegahan infeksi, perlindungan kerahasiaan data, serta penegakan kebijakan tanpa toleransi terhadap pelecehan dan diskriminasi.

Sebagai bagian dari komitmen terhadap lingkungan kerja yang aman dan inklusif, Permata Bank menerapkan kebijakan pencegahan dan penanganan pelecehan di tempat kerja. Kebijakan ini mengatur definisi pelecehan, tata cara penanganan, serta mekanisme pelaporan yang dapat diakses oleh seluruh karyawan. Bank secara aktif mendorong pelaporan atas setiap dugaan pelecehan. Bank juga memiliki prosedur penanganan yang mencakup proses investigasi dan jalur eskalasi dengan melibatkan atasan dan pihak independen untuk menjamin objektivitas serta meminimalkan gangguan dalam penanganan kasus, termasuk perlindungan terhadap privasi pelapor. [406-1]

Dalam rangka mendukung pemberdayaan perempuan, Bank pun menjalankan Women Empowerment Program (WEP) dengan membentuk Steering Committee Women Empowerment. Komite ini bertugas mengembangkan berbagai inisiatif pemberdayaan perempuan Permata yang mencakup aspek ekonomi, sosial, dan kesehatan. Sebagai bagian dari implementasi program, Bank menyelenggarakan forum "Women Talk" dengan berbagai tema bahasan yang bertujuan memperluas wawasan dan pengetahuan untuk memperlengkapi perempuan Permata menjadi lebih berdaya. Dua tema yang diangkat pada semester pertama adalah "Embracing Menopause as a Woman's Journey"

# EMPLOYEE EQUALITY AND DIVERSITY [F.18]

Permata Bank believes that a workforce with diverse backgrounds enriches perspectives and strengthens innovation capacity, which ultimately supports business growth. In line with this belief, the Bank applies diversity and inclusivity principles without discrimination based on religion, race, or gender, and promotes representation across age groups in the workplace. The Bank's commitment to diversity is reflected in the application of gender equity principles integrated into the Employee Code of Conduct and the Equal Dignity and Respect in the Workplace Policy. The Bank also safeguards the rights of employees living with HIV/AIDS through HIV/AIDS procedures that govern emergency response, infection prevention, data confidentiality protection, and enforcement of a zero-tolerance policy toward harassment and discrimination.

As part of its commitment to a safe and inclusive workplace, Permata Bank implements policies on the prevention and handling of workplace harassment. These policies set out the definition of harassment, handling procedures, and reporting mechanisms accessible to all employees. The Bank actively encourages reporting of any suspected harassment. The Bank also maintains handling procedures that include investigation processes and escalation pathways involving supervisors and independent parties to ensure objectivity and minimize disruption in case handling, including protection of the reporter's privacy. [406-1]

To support women's empowerment, the Bank implements the Women Empowerment Program (WEP) through the establishment of a Women Empowerment Steering Committee. The Committee is responsible for developing various Permata women's empowerment initiatives covering economic, social, and health aspects. As part of the program's implementation, the Bank held "Women Talk" forums with a range of themes aimed at broadening insights and knowledge to further empower women at Permata. In the first half of the year, the themes covered were "Embracing Menopause as a Woman's Journey" and "Kartini Trilogy Book Discussion", while in the second half the themes

Permata Bank membangun komunikasi dua arah dengan seluruh karyawan yang diwakili oleh serikat pekerja. Melalui forum ini, serikat pekerja dan manajemen secara aktif melakukan diskusi dua bulanan untuk membahas isu ketenagakerjaan dan mendukung terciptanya lingkungan kerja yang harmonis. # HUMAN RIGHTS, CHILD LABOR, AND FORCED LABOR [F.19]

Permata Bank integrates human rights principles into the Bank's Recruitment Procedure as an operational guideline, including provisions on child labor and forced labor. The Bank implements this policy by setting a minimum employee age of 18 and ensuring compliance starting from the recruitment process. With these measures in place, throughout 2025 there were no violations related to child labor or forced labor and no breaches of human rights principles across the Bank's business chain.

# LABOR UNIONS AND COLLECTIVE LABOR AGREEMENTS [2-30]

Permata Bank encourages two-way communication with all employees through the labor union as employee representative. Through this forum, the labor union and management actively hold bi-monthly discussions to address employment-related matters and support a harmonious workplace. As of the end of 2025, labor union membership totaled 4,000 people, representing 59% of total employees.

Through ongoing dialogue, management and the labor union agree on a Collective Labor Agreement (CLA), which is updated every two years. The CLA in effect for the 2025-2027 period serves as the basis for regulating the legal rights and obligations between the Bank and PermataBankers, covering 100% of employees. In addition, both parties routinely hold meetings to discuss evolving industrial relations matters to foster a comfortable and harmonious work environment.

# CUTI KARYAWAN

Karyawan perempuan memperoleh hak cuti melahirkan selama 3 bulan dan cuti keguguran hingga 1,5 bulan, sementara karyawan laki-laki berhak atas cuti ayah selama 5 hari serta cuti keguguran selama 3 hari. Bank memastikan bahwa pengambilan cuti tidak mengakibatkan hilangnya status maupun hak karyawan. Sepanjang tahun 2025, tercatat 249 karyawan, terdiri dari 132 perempuan dan 117 laki-laki, telah memanfaatkan hak cuti melahirkan dan cuti ayah, dengan tingkat kembali bekerja sebesar 100%. [401-3]

Permata Bank memberikan fleksibilitas pengaturan cuti melalui pemberian cuti di luar tanggungan (unpaid leave) berdasarkan ketentuan tertentu, tanpa menghilangkan manfaat asuransi kesehatan dan manfaat lainnya. Bank juga menyediakan cuti khusus, termasuk cuti ibadah, cuti ulang tahun yang dapat diambil satu hari pada hari ulang tahun karyawan, serta cuti CSER bagi karyawan yang terlibat dalam kegiatan tanggung jawab sosial dan lingkungan.

# SURVEI KETERIKATAN KARYAWAN [2-16][2-26]

Permata Bank melakukan evaluasi atas strategi pengelolaan PermataBankers melalui pengukuran tingkat pengalaman karyawan yang dilaksanakan melalui Voice of PermataBankers Survey oleh konsultan global independen. Pada tahun 2025, 82% karyawan menyebut Permata Bank sebagai "Great Place To Work", dan 75% karyawan menyatakan memiliki pengalaman kerja positif.

# PENGADUAN MASALAH KETENAGAKERJAAN [2-26][FN-CB-510a.2]

Permata Bank menerapkan prosedur Penanganan Keluh Kesah untuk memastikan setiap permasalahan karyawan ditangani secara langsung, adil, dan objektif. PermataBankers dapat menyampaikan keluhan ketenagakerjaan secara informal melalui diskusi dengan atasan. Apabila belum terselesaikan, keluhan dapat diteruskan kepada Direktorat People & Culture dan/atau melalui serikat pekerja untuk disampaikan kepada Direktorat People & Culture dengan dukungan advokasi dari serikat pekerja sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan. Selain mekanisme informal, Bank juga menyediakan saluran formal melalui whistleblowing system (WBS) yang dapat diakses melalui surat elektronik, telepon, maupun e-form pada situs web Permata Bank.

# EMPLOYEE LEAVE

Female employees are entitled to 3 months of maternity leave and up to 1.5 months of miscarriage leave, while male employees are entitled to 5 days of paternity leave and 3 days of miscarriage leave. The Bank ensures that taking leave does not result in the loss of an employee's status or rights. Throughout 2025, there were 249 employees, consisting of 132 women and 117 men, utilized maternity and paternity leave entitlements, with a 100% return-to-work rate. [401-3]

Permata Bank provides flexibility in leave arrangements through unpaid leave, subject to certain conditions, without eliminating health insurance coverage and other benefits. The Bank also provides special leave, including religious leave, birthday leave that may be taken as one day on the employee's birthday, and CSER leave for employees involved in social and environmental responsibility activities.

# EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT SURVEY [2-16][2-26]

Permata Bank evaluates its management strategy for PermataBankers by measuring employee experience levels through the Voice of PermataBankers Survey conducted by an independent global consultant. By 2025, 82% of employees will call Permata Bank a "Great Place to Work," and 75% will report having a positive work experience.

# LABOR-RELATED GRIEVANCES [2-26] [FN-CB-510a.2]

Permata Bank implements a Grievance Handling procedure to ensure that employee issues are addressed promptly, fairly, and objectively. PermataBankers may raise employment-related grievances informally through discussions with their supervisors. If it has not been resolved, the complaint can be forwarded to the People & Culture Directorate and/or through the labor union to be submitted to the People & Culture Directorate supported by the labor union advocacy in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. In addition to informal mechanisms, the Bank also provides formal channels through the whistleblowing system (WBS), accessible via email, telephone, or an e-form on Permata Bank's website.

# PENSION PROGRAM [201-3][404-2]

Permata Bank implements a defined contribution pension program under which the Bank contributes  $9\%$  of an employee's base salary toward pension premiums. In addition, PermataBankers are provided flexibility to manage their pension contributions independently through the systems and mechanisms provided by the Bank, based on individual needs. The Bank also provides a retirement benefits program for employees entering normal retirement, which includes pre-retirement training, leave facilities of up to one week per month, and additional retirement benefit payments. In 2025, the pre-retirement training program was attended by 157 PermataBankers, covering soft skills and technical skills development for the post-retirement period.

# FAIR PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT [404-3]

Permata Bank builds a fair and transparent workplace through the implementation of an objective performance appraisal system. The performance appraisal process is conducted constructively by establishing corporate-level key performance indicators (KPIs), which are then cascaded into individual performance objectives (IPOs) for each employee. The established KPIs also include bankwide KPIs related to Sustainability. Each leader is responsible for ensuring alignment between individual targets and work unit targets. KPI and IPO achievement results are communicated to employees as part of periodic performance evaluations, supported by leaders' roles as mentors through guidance and feedback.

Permata Bank determines a final performance rating as the final outcome of the performance evaluation, which serves as a reference for decisions related to promotion, rotation, and remuneration. PermataBankers are provided the opportunity to raise objections to their assessment results. As a follow-up, the Bank implements a Performance Guidance and Development program (BPK) with a duration of 4-11 months based on the evaluation results. As of the end of 2025, performance evaluations were conducted for  $92.4\%$  of total employees.

## Sistem Manajemen Kesehatan dan Keselamatan K3 (SMK3) [403-1][403-8]
Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS)

Permata Bank telah menerapkan Sistem Manajemen Kesehatan dan Keselamatan Kerja (SMK3) yang mencakup seluruh (100%) PermataBankers sebagaimana diatur dalam Kebijakan Kesehatan, Keselamatan Kerja, dan Lingkungan (K3L). Penerapan SMK3 bertujuan untuk mewujudkan lingkungan kerja yang layak, aman, dan nyaman bagi karyawan, nasabah, mitra, serta pemangku kepentingan lainnya. Implementasi SMK3 dikelola oleh Departemen Security, Safety & Support Management (SSSM) di bawah Divisi Corporate Real Estate Services (CRES) dalam Direktorat Finance and Sharia Business Unit.

Permata Bank implements an Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSMS) covering all (100%) PermataBankers, as set out in the Occupational Health, Safety, and Environment Policy. The implementation of OHSMS aims to create a proper, safe, and comfortable working environment for employees, customers, partners, and other stakeholders. OHSMS implementation is managed by the Security, Safety and Support Management (SSSM) Department under the Corporate Real Estate Services (CRES) Division within the Finance and Sharia Business Unit Directorate.

## Identifikasi Risiko K3 [403-2]
OHS Risk Identification

Permata Bank melaksanakan pengelolaan K3 sesuai dengan Kebijakan K3L melalui identifikasi bahaya dan ancaman kerja, penilaian dan penanganan risiko K3, keamanan (security), serta kelangsungan usaha (business continuity planning/BCP). Penerapan ini mendukung pencegahan kecelakaan kerja, penyakit akibat kerja, dan kerusakan lingkungan. Selama periode pelaporan, identifikasi bahaya dilakukan melalui Building Risk Assessment (BRA) dan HSE Management Audit (HMA) di 16 kantor cabang utama. Bank mencatat 41 temuan BRA, 4 temuan HMA dan seluruhnya (100%) telah diselesaikan di akhir tahun 2025.

Permata Bank manages occupational health and safety (OHS) in accordance with its OHS and Environment (HSE) Policy through the identification of workplace hazards and threats, OHS risk assessment and mitigation, security, and business continuity planning (BCP). This implementation supports the prevention of workplace accidents, occupational diseases, and environmental damage. During the reporting period, hazard identification was conducted through Building Risk Assessments (BRAs) and HSE Management Audits (HMAs) at 16 main branch offices. The Bank recorded 41 BRAs findings and 4 HMAs findings, with all (100%) completed by the end of 2025.

Permata Bank provides a Flexible Benefit scheme that enables PermataBankers to select and access health benefits flexibly based on individual needs. # Evaluasi Keamanan Produk [F.27][F.29]

# Product Safety Evaluation

Permata Bank memastikan seluruh produk dan layanan digital memenuhi ketentuan regulator sebelum dipasarkan, di mana berdasarkan risk assessment sesuai dengan ketentuan Bank Indonesia, dilakukan audit keamanan TI, untuk tingkat risiko sedang dan tinggi. Evaluasi dilakukan melalui proses penilaian risiko (risk assessment), audit keamanan TI, pengujian keamanan (penetration testing), evaluasi proses dan prosedur operational standar, serta Security Operation Center (SOC) yang beroperasi secara berkelanjutan selama 24 jam sehari dan 7 hari seminggu. Di samping itu, pengujian keamanan TI juga melibatkan pihak ketiga independen yang merupakan anggota Self-Regulatory Organization (SRO) atau Asosiasi Sistem Pembayaran Indonesia (ASPI) yang ditunjuk oleh Bank Indonesia.

Permata Bank juga menerapkan standar keamanan dan perizinan Bank Indonesia dan OJK dalam pengelolaan produk dan layanan baru, termasuk kewajiban kepemilikan laporan perizinan dan tidak adanya temuan terbuka dari penetration test serta audit TI. Layanan yang telah memperoleh izin dimonitor sesuai prosedur SLA TI dan mekanisme change management, yang mensyaratkan pelaksanaan security acceptance test sebelum digunakan kepada dilakukan perubahan. Dengan mekanisme tersebut, sepanjang tahun 2025, tidak terdapat produk dan layanan keuangan yang ditarik dari program penjualan.

Permata Bank ensures that all digital products and services comply with regulatory requirements before being launched to the market. Based on risk assessments in accordance with provisions issued by Bank Indonesia, IT security audits are conducted for products classified as medium and high risk. Evaluations are carried out through risk assessment processes, IT security audits, penetration testing, reviews of operational processes and standard operating procedures, and continuous monitoring by the Security Operation Center (SOC) operating 24 hours a day 7 days a week. In addition IT security testing also involves independent third parties that are members of a Self Regulatory Organization (SRO) or the Asosiasi Sistem Pembayaran Indonesia appointed by Bank Indonesia.

Permata Bank also applies Bank of Indonesia and Financial Services Authority security standards and licensing requirements in managing new products and services, including the requirement to hold the relevant licensing documentation and to have no open findings from penetration testing and IT audits. Licensed services are monitored in accordance with IT SLA procedures and change management mechanisms, which require a security acceptance test to be conducted before use or before any changes are implemented. With these mechanisms in place, throughout 2025 no financial products or services were withdrawn from sales programs.
