# Cybersecurity

Seiring meningkatnya digitalisasi perbankan, Permata Bank memperkuat pengelolaan keamanan siber melalui penerapan kontrol internal yang efektif dan sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Bank berupaya memitigasi risiko keamanan informasi yang dapat berdampak pada system, proses, sumber daya manusia, dan pihak ketiga, serta memastikan risiko tersebut tetap berada dalam batas yang terkendali.

Sebagai wujud komitmen terhadap ketahanan siber, Bank memiliki Cyber Security Program, yang berfokus pada penguatan Tata Kelola, Kapabilitas serta keamanan dan ketahanan siber (KKS) sebagai bagian dari upaya menjaga keberlangsungan layanan, perlindungan data, dan stabilitas operasional perusahaan. Program ini secara berkala di bahas pada IT Steering Committee (ITSC) Selain itu, Bank telah memperoleh sertifikasi ISO 27001:2022 Sistem Manajemen Keamanan Informasi pada lingkup Pengembangan dan Operasional Core Banking System. Bank juga melakukan penilaian tahunan atas tingkat maturitas ketahanan dan keamanan siber berdasarkan SEOJK Nomor 29/SEOJK.03/2022 tentang Ketahanan dan Keamanan Siber bagi Bank Umum, dan PADG 24 Tahun 2024 tentang Keamanan Sistem Informasi dan Ketahanan Siber bagi Penyelenggara Sistem Pembayaran dengan telah yang dilaporkan kepada OJK dan Bank Indonesia.

Pengelolaan risiko keamanan siber didelegasikan kepada Unit Kerja Information Security Risk Management di bawah Direktorat Risiko sebagai Lini Pertahanan Kedua, yang bekerja sama dengan Departemen Cyber Security Operations dan Technology Risk Governance & PMO di bawah Direktorat Technology sebagai Lini Pertahanan Pertama. Kedua unit secara proaktif melakukkan identifikasi, pemantauan, dan evaluasi risiko keamanan informasi, serta melaporkan potensi maupun insiden kepada Komite Risiko. Risiko keamanan siber diintegrasikan dengan risiko lainnya dan dikelola melalui kerangka enterprise risk management framework yang diturunkan ke dalam risk type framework, termasuk risiko keamanan informasi.

As banking digitalization continues to expand, Permata Bank strengthens cybersecurity management by implementing effective internal controls in line with applicable requirements. The Bank seeks to mitigate information security risks that may affect systems, processes, human resources, and third parties, and to ensure these risks remain within controlled limits.

As a manifestation of its commitment to cyber resilience, the Bank has established a Cyber Security Program focused on strengthening governance capabilities as well as cyber security and resilience as part of its efforts to ensure service continuity data protection and operational stability. The program is regularly discussed at the IT Steering Committee (ITSC). In addition the Bank has obtained ISO 27001:2022 Information Security Management System certification covering the development and operations of the Core Banking System. The Bank also conducts an annual assessment of its cyber resilience and security maturity level in accordance with SEOJK Number 29/SEOJK.03/2022 concerning Cyber Resilience and Security for Commercial Banks issued by Otoritas Jasa Keuangan and PADG 24 of 2024 concerning Information System Security and Cyber Resilience for Payment System Providers issued by Bank Indonesia with the results reported to Financial Services Authority and Bank of Indonesia.

Cybersecurity risk management is delegated to the Information Security Risk Management unit under the Risk Directorate as the Second Line of Defense, working in coordination with the Cyber Security Operations Department and Technology Risk Governance & PMO under the Technology Directorate as the First Line of Defense. Both units proactively identify, monitor, and evaluate information security risks, and report potential issues and incidents to the Risk Committee. Cybersecurity risk is integrated with other risks and managed through the enterprise risk management framework, which is cascaded into the risk type framework, including information security risk.

Domain ini didukung oleh kebijakan dan prosedur yang komprehensif untuk memastikan akuntabilitas dan mekanisme pengawasan yang tepat

2. Identifikasi
Mencakup penerapan program manajemen risiko, proses penilaian risiko, serta fungsi audit untuk mengelola risiko keamanan informasi dan menilai efektivitas pengendalian utama.

3. Perlindungan
Berfokus pada upaya pencegahan pelanggaran keamanan informasi terhadap aset-aset informasi Bank.

4. Deteksi
Meliputi deteksi ancaman dan kerentanan, aktivitas ganjil, dan deteksi peristiwa yang memperingatkan adanya kejanggalan dalam jaringan dan sistem yang menunjukkan bahwa suatu insiden telah atau mungkin akan terjadi.

5. Respons & Pemulihan
Mencakup proses penetapan, identifikasi, dan analisis peristiwa keamanan, penentuan prioritas penanganan atau mitigasi, serta pelaporan kepada pemangku kepentingan yang tepat. Meliputi perencanaan dan pengujian untuk memelihara dan memulihkan operasi yang sedang berlangsung selama dan setelah insiden keamanan informasi.

6. Kesadaran Situasi
Mencakup proses identifikasi, analisis, dan pemahaman ancaman keamanan informasi secara efektif, termasuk mekanisme berbagi informasi baik secara internal maupun dengan pihak ketiga yang tepat.

7. Manajemen Risiko Pihak Ketiga
Melibatkan pengembangan dan pemeliharaan program komprehensif untuk mengawasi dan mengelola koneksi eksternal dan hubungan pihak ketiga dengan akses ke aset teknologi dan informasi.

1. Governance
Oversight of all information security stakeholders, including the Board of Directors and management, in developing and implementing an effective information security program. This domain is supported by comprehensive policies and procedures to ensure accountability and adequate oversight mechanisms across the organization.

2. Identification
Covers the implementation of risk management programs, risk assessment processes, and audit functions to manage information security risks and assess the effectiveness of key controls.

3. Protection
Focused on preventing information security breaches through Bank's information assets.

4. Detection
Includes the detection of threats and vulnerabilities, abnormal activities, and events indicating potential or actual security incidents across networks and systems.

5. Response and Recovery
Covers the processes for establishing, identifying, and analyzing security events, prioritizing response or mitigation actions, and reporting to relevant stakeholders. This domain also includes planning and testing to maintain and restore operational continuity during and after information security incidents.

6. Situational Awareness
Includes processes to identify, analyze, and understand information security threats effectively, including information-sharing mechanisms both internally and with relevant third parties.

7. Third-Party Risk Management
Includes developing and maintaining a comprehensive program to oversee and manage relationships with third parties that have access to the Bank's technology and information assets.

# CUSTOMER COMPLAINT HANDLING

[F.24][2-25][2-26]

Permata Bank provides an integrated customer service and complaint handling mechanism to ensure optimal fulfillment of customer rights. Requests for information, service requests, and complaints from customers and non-customers are handled through the Contact Center (Permata Tel) via multiple communication channels, including telephone, email, and social media. Meanwhile, satisfaction surveys and complaint resolution are managed by the Customer Care Center (CCC) to ensure issues are addressed promptly and appropriately. Client Services Group (CSG) which serves the needs, information, requests, and complaints of non-individual customers (corporate and commercial customers); and CX Office which focuses on the overall customer experience when transacting with Permata Bank, which includes the execution and supervision of customer satisfaction surveys and follow-up of the survey results received, both conducted internally by Permata Bank and externally.

To strengthen the national complaint system, Permata Bank participates in Financial Services Authority programs by using the reporting channel for transactions suspected of fraud on the Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) website, enabling customer reports to be followed up more effectively.

In 2025, to realize Permata Bank's commitment to providing a pleasant transaction experience, Permata Bank will use the net promoter score (NPS) measurement method, which focuses on the ratio of the number of customers who would recommend Permata Bank to others (with a score of 9 and 10) to the number of customers who would not (with a score of 0-6). This NPS calculation is carried out in a massive, structured, and planned manner at all customer interaction points, from Permata Tel, Permata ME, PermataNet, to offline services at Permata Bank branches and RMs.

In addition to this measurement method, Permata Bank management also demonstrated its commitment by establishing a Customer Advocacy Committee (CAC). This committee was established with 2 main objectives:

1. To build transparency in the processes and results of all stakeholders involved, in order to become a leader in NPS in the Indonesian banking industry.
2. To serve as a collaborative platform for all Permata Bank stakeholders to assess, improve, and enhance various banking services and products, starting from customer feedback.

In 2025, Permata Bankir Cilik adopted a mindful, meaningful, and joyful learning approach to strengthen 6 foundational literacies: reading and writing, numeracy, financial, digital, scientific, cultural, and civic literacy.

Project based learning across subjects remained a core component of the program. Character development was also consistently emphasized, instilling values of courage, creativity, and leadership. Participants were introduced to simple financial management habits through financial journaling using the 3 in concept: Save in, Spend in, and Share in, while practicing consistent saving habits in daily life. The program also introduced students to the banking world through a virtual tour of Bank Indonesia Museum and visits to Permata Bank branch offices, enabling participants to understand banking functions and activities, including the roles of ATMs, Customer Service officers, and Tellers.

The program was conducted in collaboration with PiBo, a children's literacy platform and pioneer of Indonesia's digital children's library, featuring a comprehensive and interactive curriculum covering financial literacy, reading literacy, digital literacy, communication skills, and environmental awareness.

Each year, the program incorporates a specific enrichment theme to raise awareness of current societal issues. # AKTIVITAS UNIT PENGELOLA ZAKAT DAN DANA KEBAJIKAN (UPZDK)

Permata Bank melalui unit usahanya, yaitu Unit Usaha Syariah (UUS), bekerja sama dengan berbagai mitra dalam pelaksanaan berbagai program tanggung jawab sosial melalui Unit Pengelola Zakat dan Dana Kebajikan (UPZDK). Pada tahun 2025, UPZDK menyalurkan dana sebesar Rp17 Miliar yang diberikan kepada 32.121 penerima manfaat yang terbagi dalam asnaf Miskin, Fisabilillah, Gharimin, dan Mualaf serta 26 lembaga/yayasan. Adapun pelaksanaan kegiatan UPZDK terbagi ke dalam 6 pilar program, antara lain:

1. Pendidikan
UPZDK secara aktif dan berkelanjutan dalam upaya memperluas akses dan kualitas pendidikan melalui pemberian program beasiswa kepada mahasiswa di berbagai perguruan tinggi negeri/swasta yang memiliki kendalan dalam finansial, pemberian beasiswa ekonomi penyediaan ruang belajar yang inklusif kepada anak-anak prasejahtera, pemberian dukungan untuk sertifikasi para guru yang memadai dan berbagai program yang dilaksanakan sebagai bentuk komitmen untuk membantu para penerima manfaat dapat melanjutkan pendidikan, meningkatkan kompetensi, serta mendorong terwujudnya kemandirian dan peningkatan kulitas sumber daya manusia.

2. Kesehatan
UPZDK berkomitmen dalam membantu pemenuhan hak dasar kesehatan masyarakat melalui akses layanan kesehatan bagi masyarakat kurang mampu melalui kerja sama dengan berbagai mitra ataupun rumah sakit. Bantuan diberikan melalui pemberian obat-obatan gratis, khitanan massal, penyediaan ambulance gratis, serta pemberian bantuan Kesehatan lainnya sesuai dengan kebutuhan penerima manfaat. Through its business unit, the Sharia Business Unit (SBU), Permata Bank partners with various organizations to implement social responsibility programs through the Zakat and Benevolent Funds Management Unit (UPZDK). In 2025, UPZDK disbursed IDR 17 billion to 32,121 beneficiaries across the asnaf categories of Miskin, Fisabilillah, Gharimin, and Mualaf, as well as 26 institutions/foundations. UPZDK actively and continuously expands access to and improves the quality of education through scholarship programs for students at various public and private universities facing financial constraints, economic scholarships and the provision of inclusive learning spaces for underprivileged children, support for adequate teacher certification, and other programs. UPZDK is committed to supporting the fulfillment of basic health rights by providing access to health services for underprivileged communities through cooperation with various partners and hospitals. UPZDK carries out various economic empowerment activities to improve community welfare and quality of life, including:

UPZDK supports food security through agricultural programs involving underprivileged farmers in managing agricultural land, integrated with improvements in farmers' capacity, productivity, and independence through strengthened resources, knowledge, and economic access to increase agricultural output and farmer income.

Disability empowerment is an economic independence program for persons with disabilities through the development of a laying-hen farming business. Support includes production facilities and infrastructure, marketing support, and mentoring to improve quality of life through employment opportunities.

d. Tourism Economy

Empowerment through the tourism economy optimizes local tourism potential as a community income source through business actor mentoring, provision of tourism infrastructure, destination management, and development of tourism products based on local wisdom.

# Tata Kelola Keberlanjutan [2-9][2-12][2-13][2-23][2-24]
## Sustainability Governance

Permata Bank menerapkan tata kelola perusahaan berdasarkan Peraturan OJK No. 17 Tahun 2023 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola bagi Bank Umum (POJK 17/2023) serta Surat Edaran OJK No. 14/SEOJK.03/2025 tentang Penerapan Tata Kelola Bagi Bank Umum (SEOJK 14/2025) sebagai kerangka utama tata kelola perbankan. Penerapan tata Kelola di Bank berlandaskan pada prinsip keterbukaan (transparency), akuntabilitas (accountability), tanggung jawab (responsibility), independensi (independency), dan kewajaran (fairness), dengan mempertimbangkan aspek keberlanjutan dalam pengelolaan Bank. Selain itu, Permata Bank turut mengadopsi ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) 2023, best practice, serta regulasi lain yang relevan. Sebagai bagian dari reviu pedoman dan kebijakan tata kelola Bank secara berkala, pada tahun 2025, Permata Bank melakukan penyesuaian Pedoman Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi dengan ketentuan SEOJK 14/2025.

Pada tahun 2025, Permata Bank telah memiliki Kebijakan Keberlanjutan, yang berfungsi sebagai kebijakan payung dalam setiap pelaksanaan keberlanjutan di operasional hingga bisnis Bank. Sejalan dengan visi keberlanjutan untuk menjadi mitra keuangan terpercaya yang mendorong transformasi menuju ekonomi yang berkelanjutan, inklusif, dan bertanggung jawab, Permata Bank mengintegrasikan prinsip keuangan berkelanjutan dalam seluruh aktivitas bisnisnya. Melalui misi keberlanjutan, Bank berkomitmen untuk menyediakan layanan keuangan yang inovatif dan bertanggung jawab, berkontribusi pada pelestarian lingkungan dan kesetaraan sosial, serta membangun bisnis yang transparan, akuntabel, dan beretika melalui pengelolaan risiko keberlanjutan yang efektif dan kolaborasi dengan para pemangku kepentingan.

Komitmen tersebut diimplementasikan melalui empat pilar keberlanjutan, yaitu Sustainable Business, Sustainable Operations, Sustainable Impact for Communities, dan Sustainability Governance. Keempat pilar ini mencakup pengembangan produk dan pembiayaan berkelanjutan, penerapan praktik operasional yang ramah lingkungan dan inklusif, pemberdayaan masyarakat melalui literasi keuangan dan program sosial-lingkungan, serta penguatan tata kelola yang baik, manajemen risiko, dan perlindungan pemangku kepentingan. Seluruh inisiatif keberlanjutan Permata Bank dilandasi oleh nilai inti I-PRICE, yaitu Integrity, Partnership, Responsiveness, Innovation, Caring, dan Excellence, serta selaras dengan Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (TPB).

Permata Bank implements corporate governance in accordance with the provisions of POJK No. 17 of 2023 on the Implementation of Governance for Commercial Banks, which serves as the main framework for banking governance. In its development, the Bank adjusts its governance policies and procedures to align with evolving sustainability needs and challenges. These adjustments aim to ensure that the principles of transparency, accountability, responsibility, independence, and fairness continue to be applied consistently, while incorporating sustainability considerations into the Bank's management. In addition, Permata Bank has adopted the ASEAN Corporate Governance Scorecard (ACGS) 2023, best practices, and other relevant regulations. As part of its periodic review of the Bank's governance guidelines and policies, in 2025, Permata Bank updated the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors Guidelines to align with SEOJK 14/2025.

In 2025, Permata Bank maintains its Sustainability Policy, which serves as an umbrella policy for the implementation of sustainability across the Bank's operations and business. In line with its sustainability vision to become a trusted financial partner that drives transformation toward a sustainable, inclusive, and responsible economy, Permata Bank integrates sustainable finance principles across all business activities. Through its sustainability mission, the Bank is committed to providing innovative and responsible financial services, contributing to environmental conservation and social equity, and building a transparent, accountable, and ethical business through effective sustainability risk management and collaboration with stakeholders.

This commitment is implemented through four sustainability pillars: Sustainable Business, Sustainable Operations, Sustainable Impact for Communities, and Sustainability Governance. These pillars cover the development of sustainable products and financing, the application of environmentally friendly and inclusive operational practices, community empowerment through financial literacy and social-environmental programs, and the strengthening of good governance, risk management, and stakeholder protection. All of Permata Bank's sustainability initiatives are guided by the core I-PRICE values of Integrity, Partnership, Responsiveness, Innovation, Caring, and Excellence; and align with the SDGs.

# Komite yang Terkait dengan Keberlanjutan
Committees Related to Sustainability

## KOMITE KEBERLANJUTAN

Pada tahun 2023 Bank membentuk Komite Keberlanjutan untuk meningkatkan pengawasan terhadap isu-su keberlanjutan. Komite Keberlanjutan mengadakan pertemuan secara berkala, setidaknya empat kali dalam setahun. Komite keberlanjutan terdiri dari anggota tetap dengan hak suara, yaitu Direktur Utama, Direktur Risiko, dan Direktur Keuangan, serta anggota tetap tanpa hak suara, yang terdiri dari Chief dan Kepala Divisi terkait. Antara lain, Corporate Banking, Commercial Banking, International Business Development & Advisory, Treasury, Sustainability, Corporate Communication, dan Consumer Lending. Komite Keberlanjutan bertugas melakukan pengawasan serta mendorong pelaksanaan inisiatif keberlanjutan di Permata Bank, mengintegrasikan aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (LST) ke dalam strategi, kebijakan, dan praktik bisnis Bank, serta memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan yang berlaku, keselarasan dengan standar industri, dan praktik umum terkait keberlanjutan di sektor perbankan.

## KOMITE PEMANTAU RISIKO

Komite Pemantau Risiko (KPR) berperan mengevaluasi konsistensi antara kebijakan manajemen risiko termasuk risiko iklim, dengan pelaksanaan kebijakan Bank dalam rangka memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris, serta memonitor dan mengevaluasi pelaksanaan tugas Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Satuan Kerja Manajemen Risiko dalam rangka memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris. Penjelasan lebih lanjut terkait term of references (TOR) Komite Pemantauan Risiko dapat mengacu pada Laporan Tahunan Permata Bank.

## KOMITE MANAJEMEN RISIKO

Komite Manajemen Risiko (KMR) bertugas untuk mengevaluasi dan merekomendasikan kebijakan manajemen risiko, strategi, risk appetite, toleransi risiko, limit risiko, kerangka kerja manajemen risiko, dan rencana kontinjensi untuk mengantisipasi kondisi abnormal, serta memastikan eksposur risiko untuk semua jenis risiko di termasuk risiko iklim, di Bank tetap sesuai dengan risk appetite.

KMR juga memastikan penerapan kerangka kerja manajemen risiko termasuk kerangka kerja risiko (risk type framework/RTF) iklim di Permata Bank telah berjalan dengan efektif. Penjelasan lebih lanjut terkait terms of references (TOR) Komite Manajemen Risiko dapat mengacu pada Laporan Tahunan Permata Bank.

## SUSTAINABILITY COMMITTEE

In 2023, the Bank established the Sustainability Committee to strengthen oversight of sustainability matters. The Sustainability Committee holds regular meetings, at least four times a year. It comprises permanent voting members, namely the President Director, Risk Director, and Finance Director, as well as permanent non-voting members consisting of relevant Chiefs and Division Heads, including Corporate Banking, Commercial Banking, International Business Development and Advisory, Treasury, Sustainability, Corporate Communication, and Consumer Lending. The Sustainability Committee is responsible for providing oversight and driving the implementation of sustainability initiatives at Permata Bank, integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) aspects into the Bank's strategy, policies, and business practices, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, alignment with industry standards, and common sustainability practices in the banking sector.

## RISK MONITORING COMMITTEE

The Risk Monitoring Committee (RMOC) evaluates the consistency between risk management policies, including climate risk, and the Bank's policy implementation in order to provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners. The Committee also monitors and evaluates the execution of duties by the Risk Management Committee and the Risk Management Work Unit in order to provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners. Further details on the Risk Monitoring Committee's terms of reference (TOR) are presented in Permata Bank's Annual Report.

## RISK MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE

The Risk Management Committee (RMC) evaluates and recommends risk management policies, strategy, risk appetite, risk tolerance, risk limits, the risk management framework, and contingency plans to anticipate abnormal conditions, and ensures the Bank's risk exposures across all risk types, including climate risk, remain within the approved risk appetite.

The RMC also ensures the effective implementation of the risk management framework, including the climate risk type framework (RTF), at Permata Bank. Further details on the Risk Management Committee's terms of reference (TOR) are presented in Permata Bank's Annual Report.

Sustainable Finance Training and Development

Selain untuk kepentingan internal, Permata Bank juga memberikan peningkatan kapasitas terkait bisnis berkelanjutan kepada pihak eksternal, yaitu kepada nasabah dan vendor. # Manajemen Risiko [E.3]
Risk Management

Permata Bank menerapkan manajemen risiko sebagai bagian dari kerangka pengelolaaan usaha Bank. Seluruh risiko material dikelola berdasarkan enterprise risk management framework (ERMF) melalui rangkaian proses identifikasi, pengukuran, pemantauan, dan pengendalian yang dijalankan secara konsisten di seluruh aktivitas operasional Bank. Pengelolaaan ini ditujukan untuk menjaga ketahanan usaha sekaligus mengendalikan potensi dampak risiko terhadap aspek ekonomi, sosial, lingkungan, dan tata kelola. Strategi manajemen risiko dirancang untuk mendukung kesinambungan usaha dan penciptaan nilai bagi pemangku kepentingan dengan memperhatikan kondisi internal dan eksternal Bank.

Risiko dan peluang bisnis utama yang berkaitan dengan aspek lingkungan, sosial, dan tata kelola (LST) dipantau serta dinilai melalui Komite Keberlanjutan. Pemantauan tersebut didukung oleh kajian manajemen risiko yang mencakup seluruh aspek operasional Bank, termasuk risiko terkait LST dan ekonomi. Dalam kerangka pengelolaaan risiko tersebut, Permata Bank mengelola 15 tipe risiko utama, yaitu Risiko Kredit, Risiko Pasar, Risiko Likuiditas Jangka Pendek, Risiko Likuiditas Struktural, Risiko Modal, Risiko Operasional, Risiko Keamanan Informasi, Risiko Hukum, Risiko Strategik, Risiko Kepatuhan, Risiko Imbal Hasil, Risiko Investasi, Risiko Transaksi Intra-group, serta Risiko Iklim, sesuai dengan ERMF 2025.

Lebih lanjut, sebagai bagian dari tata kelola risiko, pengelolaaan risiko iklim juga didukung oleh peran Komite Manajemen Risiko (KMR) dan Komite Pemantauan Risiko (KPR). KMR menetapkan kebijakan, kerangka kerja, serta parameter risiko yang mencakup aspek keberlanjutan, termasuk risk appetite dan risk tolerance terkait risiko iklim, dan memastikan penerapannya terintegrasi dalam proses bisnis. Sementara itu, KPR menjalankan fungsi pengawasan independen atas implementasi kebijakan tersebut dengan menilai keselarasan antara arahan yang telah ditetapkan dan praktik pelaksanaannya, serta memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris untuk memastikan efektivitas tata kelola pengelolaaan risiko iklim.

Dalam kerangka pengelolaaan Risiko Iklim sebagai bagian dari risiko material Bank, Permata Bank melakukan identifikasi dan penilaian Risiko Iklim secara lebih mendalam. Risiko iklim yang dinilai material dikelompokkan ke dalam dua kategori utama, yaitu Risiko Transisi dan Risiko Fisik. Risiko Transisi berkaitan dengan perubahan kebijakan, perkembangan teknologi, serta pergeseran preferensi sosial, sementara Risiko Fisik meliputi banjir, kebakaran, peningkatan suhu, dan kenaikan permukaan air laut. Identifikasi tersebut dilakukan melalui analisis skenario dan uji stres untuk menilai dampaknya terhadap strategi bisnis Bank dalam jangka pendek, menengah, dan panjang.

Permata Bank implements risk management as an integral part of the Bank's business management framework. All material risks are managed in accordance with the enterprise risk management framework (ERMF) through a series of identification, measurement, monitoring, and control processes that are applied consistently across all of the Bank's operational activities. This management approach is intended to safeguard business resilience while controlling the potential impact of risks on economic, social, environmental, and governance aspects. The risk management strategy is designed to support business continuity and value creation for stakeholders, taking into account both the Bank's internal and external conditions.

Key business risks and opportunities related to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) aspects are monitored and assessed through the Sustainability Committee, which convenes at least twice a year. This monitoring is supported by risk management assessments covering all aspects of the Bank's operations, including ESG- and economy-related risks. Within this risk management framework, Permata Bank manages 15 main risk types, namely Credit Risk, Market Risk, Short-Term Liquidity Risk, Structural Liquidity Risk, Capital Risk, Operational Risk, Information Security Risk, Legal Risk, Strategic Risk, Compliance Risk, Rate of Return Risk, Investment Risk, Intra-group Transaction Risk, and Climate Risk, in accordance with the 2025 ERMF.

In addition, as part of risk governance, climate risk management is supported by the roles of the Risk Management Committee (RMC) and the Risk Monitoring Committee (RMOC). The Risk Management Committee establishes policies, frameworks, and risk parameters that incorporate sustainability considerations, including climate risk appetite and climate risk tolerance, and ensures these are integrated into business processes. Meanwhile, the Risk Monitoring Committee provides independent oversight of implementation by assessing alignment between the established direction and execution in practice, and by providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners to support the effective governance of climate risk management.

Within the framework of Climate Risk management as part of the Bank's material risks, Permata Bank conducts more in-depth identification and assessment of Climate Risk. Climate risks deemed material are categorised into two main groups: Transition Risk and Physical Risk. Transition Risk relates to changes in policy, technological developments, and shifts in social preferences, while Physical Risk includes floods, fires, rising temperatures, and sea-level rise. This identification is carried out through scenario analysis and stress testing to assess the impact on the Bank's business strategy over the short, medium, and long term.

Pengkajian Risiko Iklim dilakukan secara berkelanjutan sepanjang siklus hubungan dengan debitur, mulai dari proses on boarding, aplikasi dan tinjauan kredit, pemantauan dan keterlibatan berkelanjutan, hingga persetujuan produk atau bisnis baru. Dalam proses tersebut, dampak Risiko Iklim dipetakan terhadap risiko keuangan dan nonkeuangan untuk menilai potensi, signifikansi, dan tingkat konsentrasinya. [F.12]

Permata Bank juga melakukan komunikasi aktif dengan debitur serta pihak ketiga yang dianggap signifikan, termasuk pemasok barang, guna memperoleh informasi yang lebih memadai mengenai pemahaman terhadap risiko iklim, rekam jejak, komitmen, dan strategi transisi dalam mengelola risiko tersebut.

Climate Risk assessment is conducted continuously throughout the debtor relationship lifecycle, starting from the onboarding process, credit application and review, ongoing monitoring and engagement, through to the approval of new products or business activities. Within this process, the impact of Climate Risk is mapped against both financial and non-financial risks to assess its potential, materiality, and level of concentration. [F.12]

Permata Bank also engages in active communication with debtors and significant third parties, including goods and service suppliers, in order to obtain more comprehensive information regarding their understanding of climate risks, track records, commitments, and transition strategies in managing such risks.

Informasi lebih lengkap mengenai pelaksanaan serta peran dari tanggung jawab Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris dalam manajemen risiko secara keseluruhan dapat dilihat dalam Bab Manajemen Risiko Laporan Tahanan 2025.

More complete information regarding the implementation, roles, and responsibilities of the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners in overall risk management can be seen in the Risk Management Chapter of 2025 Annual Report.

# Pengelolaan Risiko Iklim [2-13][201-2]

# Climate Risk Management

Sebagai bagian dari penguatan pengelolaan Risiko Iklim, Permata Bank telah mengembangkan Kerangka Kerja Tipe Risiko Iklim (Climate Risk Type Framework) dan menerapkan Taksonomi untuk Keuangan Berkelanjutan Indonesia (TKBI). Penerapan kerangka tersebut didukung oleh pembentukan fungsi Climate Risk Analytics di bawah Divisi Market & Enterprise Risk Management (MERM) yang berfokus pada pengembangan Climate Risk Stress Test (CRST) serta perhitungan Financed Emission. Secara tata kelola, pengelolaan Risiko Iklim berada di bawah pengawasan Direktur Risiko dan Chief of Corporate Affair & Sustainability selaku Risk Framework Owner (RFO), dengan dukungan RFO PIC yang terdiri dari Division Head Market & Enterprise Risk Management (MERM), Division Head Corporate, Commercial, & EBB Credit Risk Management (CCE CRM), dan Division Head Sustainability.

Tahun 2025, Permata Bank melakukan kajian pilot bottom-up Climate Risk Management & Scenario Analysis (CRMS) yang kedua sesuai dengan persyaratan regulator serta mengacu pada panduan yang ditetapkan oleh Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) berdasarkan skenario yang disusun oleh Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS) yaitu skenario Net Zero 2050, Delayed Transition, dan Current Policy terhadap Risiko Transisi dan Risiko Fisik.

As part of strengthening its climate risk management, Permata Bank has developed a Climate Risk Type Framework and applies the Indonesia Sustainable Finance Taxonomy (TKBI). Implementation of this framework is supported by the establishment of a Climate Risk Analytics function under the Market and Enterprise Risk Management (MERM) Division, which focuses on developing the Climate Risk Stress Test (CRST) and calculating financed emissions. From a governance perspective, climate risk management is overseen by the Risk Director and the Chief of Corporate Affairs & Sustainability as the Risk Framework Owner (RFO), supported by RFO PICs comprising the MERM Division Head; Corporate, Commercial, and EBB Credit Risk Management (CCE CRM) Division Head; and Sustainability Division Head.

In 2025, Permata Bank conducted its second pilot bottom-up Climate Risk Management & Scenario Analysis (CRMS) assessment in line with regulatory requirements and referring to guidance issued by the Financial Services Authority (OJK), using scenarios developed by the Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS), namely Net Zero 2050, Delayed Transition, and Current Policies, across Transition Risk and Physical Risk.

Hasil CRMS di tahun 2025 menunjukkan bahwa Risiko Transisi dan Risiko Fisik berpotensi menekan kinerja keuangan Bank yang tercermin dari penurunan profit after tax (PAT) dan capital adequacy ratio (CAR). Dalam pilot bottom-up CRMS terhadap  $100\%$  portofolio, CAR diproyeksikan menurun menjadi  $28\% - 30\%$  pada horizon jangka pendek (2025-2027) dan menjadi  $28\% - 33\%$  pada horizon jangka panjang (2030-2050), dibandingkan posisi Desember 2024 sebesar  $35\%$ .

![img-115.jpeg](img-115.jpeg)

Penurunan tersebut terutama dipengaruhi oleh peningkatan expected credit loss (ECL), penurunan pendapatan bunga akibat menjigkatnya debitur bermasalah (non-performing loan/NPL), serta kerugian nilai wajar surat berharga seiring perubahan kondisi pasar.

Proyeksi dampak tersebut diperoleh melalui uji ketahanan yang diawali dengan pengelompokan debitur ke dalam subsektor prioritas berdasarkan tingkat risiko tinggi (seperti batubara, pembangkit listrik, migas, dan perkebunan), risiko menengah (seperti industri kimia, transportasi, gula, semen, dan daging & susu), dan risiko rendah (perdagangan & jasa, properti, konstruksi, dan pengolahan makanan). Uji ketahanan dilakukan untuk periode waktu jangka pendek (2025 - 2027) maupun jangka panjang (2030 - 2050) dengan menilai perubahan credit risk grading (CRG) debitur serta implikasi finansial terhadap Permata Bank melalui proyeksi loan impairment (LI), risk weighted asset (RWA), dan capital adequacy ratio (CAR). Hasil uji ketahanan menunjukan sektor pertambangan batubara, perkebunan, dan migas merupakan sektor yang paling terdapat oleh perubahan iklim (penurunan rating customer tertinggi).

Risiko Kredit menjadi risiko terbesar bagi Bank terhadap dampak dari perubahan iklim. Kajian CRMS juga digunakan untuk mengukur dampak lintas risiko, termasuk risiko pasar, risiko likuiditas, dan risiko operasional, walaupun dampaknya tidak signifikanseperti pada risiko kredit.

The 2025 CRMS results indicate that Transition Risk and Physical Risk may put pressure on the Bank's financial performance, as reflected in a decline in profit after tax (PAT) and the capital adequacy ratio (CAR). Under the pilot bottom-up CRMS covering  $100\%$  of the portfolio, CAR is projected to decline to  $28\% - 30\%$  over the short-term horizon (2025 - 2027) and to  $28\% - 33\%$  over the long-term horizon (2030 - 2050), compared with a December 2024 position of  $35\%$ .

![img-116.jpeg](img-116.jpeg)

This decline is primarily driven by higher expected credit loss (ECL), lower interest income due to an increase in troubled debtors (non-performing loans/NPLs), and fair value losses on securities as market conditions change.

These projected impacts are derived through stress testing that begins with categorizing debtors into priority subsectors based on risk levels: high risk (such as coal, power generation, oil and gas, and plantations), medium risk (such as chemicals, transportation, sugar, cement, and meat and dairy), and low risk (trade and services, property, construction, and food processing). Stress testing is conducted for both the short-term (2025 - 2027) and long-term (2030 - 2050) periods by assessing changes in debtor Credit Risk Grading (CRG) and the resulting financial implications for Permata Bank through projections of loan impairment (LI), risk-weighted assets (RWA), and the capital adequacy ratio (CAR). The results indicate that coal mining, plantations, and oil and gas are the sectors most affected by climate change (with the largest decline in customer ratings).

Credit Risk represents the Bank's most significant risk exposure arising from climate change impacts. The CRMS assessment is also used to measure cross-risk impacts, including market risk, liquidity risk, and operational risk, although these impacts are not as significant as those on credit risk.

Tata Kelola Keberlanjutan Sustainability Governance

Pengelolaan Risiko Iklim di Permata Bank dilakukan melalui penguatan proses, tata kelola, dan koordinasi lintas fungsi. Upaya tersebut mencakup:

- Pembentukan Departemen Climate Risk Analytics pada tahun 2024 yang bertujuan untuk melakukan kajian yang lebih mendalam atas pengelolaan dan mitigasi masing-masing risiko terkait iklim.
- Pembentukan Divisi Sustainability di bawah Direktorat Corporate Affair and Sustainability yang bertanggung jawab untuk merancang mengembangkan keberlanjutan bank secara bankwide agar selaras dengan tujuan Permata Bank untuk mencapai target NZE operasional 2030 dan NZE pembiayaan 2052 serta memastikan kesesuaian dengan regulasi yang berlaku.
- Peningkatan dan pengembangan kapasitas Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM) dalam mengelola dampak risiko iklim melalui pelatihan-pelatihan eksternal.
- Pengembangan dan penerapan proses untuk memahami serta mengidentifikasi potensi dampak Risiko Iklim terhadap kegiatan usaha Bank, sekaligus mengelolanya dalam strategi bisnis dan kerangka manajemen risiko.
- Penetapan peran dan tanggung jawab Direksi, Dewan Komisaris, dan unit kerja terkait sesuai struktur organisasi, termasuk mekanisme koordinasi dan pengawasan dalam pengelolaan risiko iklim.
- Penyusunan kebijakan, prosedur, dan pengendalian internal yang efektif terkait manajemen risiko iklim.
- Integrasi risiko iklim ke dalam sistem pengendalian internal melalui penerapan model tiga lini guna memastikan proses identifikasi, pengukuran, dan mitigasi risiko berjalan secara tepat, komprehensif, dan efektif.
- Pembentukan focus group discussion (FGD) risiko iklim untuk membahas strategi, inisiatif, isu, status kemajuan, serta memperkuat koordinasi antar unit kerja yang berada di bawah lingkup risk framework owner (RFO).
- Penyampaian pembaruan informasi terkait Risiko Iklim kepada Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Komite Pemantau Risiko setidaknya satu kali dalam setahun.

Dalam pengelolaan risiko iklim, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi menjalankan fungsi pengawasan secara aktif terhadap efektivitas sistem pengendalian internal. Pelaksanaan pengawasan tersebut dilakukan sesuai dengan kewenangan dan tanggung jawab masing-masing, yang didelegasikan kepada komite di bawah Dewan Komisaris serta komite di bawah Direksi. Climate Risk Management at Permata Bank is carried out through strengthening processes, governance, and cross-functional coordination. These efforts include:

- The establishment of the Climate Risk Analytics Department in 2024 aims to conduct more comprehensive studies on climate-related risk management and mitigation.
- Establishing the Sustainability Division under the Corporate Affairs and Sustainability Directorate, which is responsible for designing and advancing bank-wide sustainability in alignment with Permata Bank's targets to achieve Net Zero Emissions (NZE) for operations by 2030 and NZE for financing by 2052, and for ensuring compliance with applicable regulations.
- Enhancing and developing human capital capacity to manage climate risk impacts through external training programs.
- Development and implementation of processes to understand and identify the potential impacts of Climate Risk on the Bank's business activities, while managing them within the business strategy and risk management framework.
- Definition of the roles and responsibilities of the Board of Directors, Board of Commissioners, and relevant work units in accordance with the organizational structure, including coordination and oversight mechanisms for climate risk management.
- Development of effective policies, procedures, and internal controls related to climate risk management.
- Integration of climate risk into the internal control system through the implementation of the three lines model to ensure the processes of risk identification, measurement, and mitigation are carried out appropriately, comprehensively, and effectively.
- Establishment of a climate risk forum to strengthen coordination between work units under the risk framework owner (RFO).
- Providing updates on Climate Risk to the Risk Management Committee and Risk Oversight Committee at least once a year.

In managing climate risk, the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors actively oversee the effectiveness of the internal control system. This oversight is carried out in accordance with their respective authorities and responsibilities, which are delegated to committees under the Board of Commissioners and committees under the Board of Directors. # Kepatuhan terhadap Hukum dan Peraturan [2-27]

Compliance with Laws and Regulations

Permata Bank menerapkan Kebijakan Kepatuhan yang wajib dipatuhi oleh seluruh karyawan. Pengawasan atas pelaksanaan fungsi kepatuhan dilakukan oleh Direktur Hukum dan Kepatuhan, dengan dukungan Divisi Compliance Regulatory Affairs Advisory, Compliance Monitoring & Training, Anti Money Laundering (AML), serta Cross Border Compliance Advisory. Masing-masing divisi memiliki tugas dan tanggung jawab yang ditetapkan untuk memastikan kepatuhan Bank terhadap peraturan yang berlaku.

Kesadaran dan budaya kepatuhan di Permata Bank dibangun melalui program pembelajaran yang berkelanjutan. Bank secara rutin menyelenggarakan pelatihan wajib berbasis e-learning mengenai budaya kepatuhan bagi seluruh karyawan setiap tahunnya. Upaya ini diperkuat dengan pelaksanaan legal sharing session oleh Divisi Litigasi yang bertujuan meningkatkan pemahaman karyawan atas prinsip prudential banking dan mendorong kepatuhan yang konsisten terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan, ketentuan regulator, serta kebijakan dan prosedur internal.

Untuk memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan yang ditetapkan oleh otoritas pengawas keuangan, termasuk Otoritas Jasa Keuangan dan Bank Indonesia, Permata Bank melalui Divisi Compliance and Regulatory Affairs menjalankan serangkaian aktivitas pengelolaan kepatuhan yang terstruktur, meliputi:

1. Pelaksanaan gap analysis atas peraturan baru yang diterbitkan regulator serta sosialisasi kepada unit kerja terkait untuk memastikan pemenuhan kewajiban sesuai jangka waktu yang ditetapkan, sebagaimana diatur dalam Department Operating Instruction (DOI) Administrasi dan Distribusi Surat serta Pemantauan, Distribusi, dan Sosialisasi Peraturan Regulator.
2. Peninjauan secara berkala atas kebijakan dan prosedur Bank guna memastikan kesesuaian dengan ketentuan yang berlaku, dengan mengacu pada Kebijakan dan Prosedur Panduan Tata Kelola Dokumen.
3. Reviu atas produk Bank, baik yang telah berjalan maupun produk baru, termasuk pelaksanaan pelaporan dan/atau perizinan kepada regulator sesuai Kebijakan dan Prosedur Pengembangan Produk Bank.
4. Pemberian konsultasi kepada unit kerja terkait dalam rangka pemenuhan ketentuan regulator yang berlaku.

Permata Bank implements a Compliance Policy that all employees must adhere to. Oversight of the compliance function is carried out by the Director of Legal and Compliance, with support from the Compliance Regulatory Affairs Advisory, Compliance Monitoring & Training, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Cross-Border Compliance Advisory Divisions. Each division has designated duties and responsibilities to ensure the Bank's compliance with applicable regulations.

Compliance awareness and culture at Permata Bank are built through continuous learning programs. The Bank regularly conducts mandatory e-learning on compliance culture for all employees each year. This effort is reinforced by the Litigation Division's legal sharing sessions, which aim to improve employees' understanding of prudential banking principles and encourage consistent compliance with laws and regulations, regulatory requirements, and internal policies and procedures.

To ensure compliance with laws and regulations stipulated by financial supervisory authorities, including the Financial Services Authority (OJK) and Bank of Indonesia, Permata Bank, through its Compliance and Regulatory Affairs Division, carries out a series of structured compliance management activities, including:

1. Conducting gap analyses on new regulations issued by regulators and disseminating them to relevant work units to ensure compliance with established timeframes, as stipulated in the Department Operating Instruction (DOI) on Administration and Distribution of Letters and Monitoring, Distribution, and Dissemination of Regulatory Regulations.
2. Periodic reviews of the Bank's policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulations, with reference to the Document Governance Guidelines Policy and Procedures.
3. Reviews of the Bank's products, both existing and new, including reporting and/or licensing to regulators in accordance with the Bank's Product Development Policy and Procedures.
4. Providing consultations to relevant work units regarding compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Anti-corruption and Anti-fraud

Dalam pengelolaan risiko penyuapan dan korupsi, Permata Bank menugaskan Divisi Bribery & Anti-Corruption sebagai fungsi yang bertanggung jawab. Bribery risk assessment dilakukan setiap tahun ke seluruh divisi yang ada di Permata Bank. # Opportunities in Implementing Sustainable Finance

Di tengah perubahan regulasi serta dinamika ekonomi, sosial, dan lingkungan, Permata Bank melihat peluang untuk memperkuat pertumbuhan bisnis melalui inovasi produk dan layanan yang mendukung keuangan berkelanjutan. Pendekatan ini membuka potensi pengembangan layanan yang lebih inklusif dan berwawasan lingkungan. Adapun peluang yang teridentifikasi sepanjang tahun 2025 antara lain:

- Bertumbuhnya industri/bisnis yang masuk dalam kategori Kegiatan Usaha Berkelanjutan, portofolio pembiayaan berkelanjutan di Permata Bank turut meningkat;
- Membantu memberikan solusi bagi nasabah yang hendak melakukan transisi menuju bisnis yang lebih berkelanjutan, sebagai bagian dari climate change opportunity;
- Penyediaan akses keuangan bagi berbagai lapisan masyarakat, termasuk kelompok unbankable, terus dijaga melalui implementasi program inklusi keuangan dan digitalisasi perbankan;
- Peningkatan portfolio berkelanjutan dapat memperbesar peluang insentif regulator yang diterima oleh Bank, misalnya pada insentif Giro Wajib Minimum (GWM) sehingga Bank dapat meningkatkan penetrasi untuk mengembangkan portofolio aset keuangan yang berkualitas tinggi; dan
- Portofolio aset yang berkualitas tinggi dapat meningkatkan profitabilitas Bank. Khusus di Unit Usaha Syariah (UUS), peningkatan profitabilitas dapat meningkatkan Dana Zakat yang akan dikelola untuk kepentingan umat dan masyarakat umum sesuai kriteria penerima zakat sehingga turut berkontribusi terhadap pertumbuhan ekonomi dan sosial secara berkelanjutan.

Amid regulatory changes and economic, social, and environmental dynamics, Permata Bank sees opportunities to strengthen business growth through product and service innovation that supports sustainable finance. This approach opens up the potential for developing more inclusive and environmentally conscious services. Opportunities identified throughout 2025 include:

- As more industries and businesses fall within the Sustainable Business Activities category, Permata Bank's sustainable financing portfolio increased accordingly;
- Helping provide solutions for customers who want to transition to a more sustainable business, as part of the climate change opportunity;
- Access to financial services across different segments of society, including the unbankable, continued to be supported through financial inclusion programs and banking digitalization;
- Growth in the sustainable portfolio may increase the Bank's eligibility for regulatory incentives, such as reserve requirement incentives, enabling the Bank to further expand a high-quality financial asset portfolio; and
- A higher-quality asset portfolio may improve the Bank's profitability. In particular, within the Sharia Business Unit (SBU), improved profitability may increase zakat funds managed for beneficiaries in accordance with zakat eligibility criteria, thereby contributing to sustainable economic and social development.

# Tantangan dan Perkembangan dari Penerapan Tata Kelola Berkelanjutan

Challenges and Progress in Implementing Sustainable Governance

Perkembangan kerangka regulasi keuangan berkelanjutan di Indonesia menunjukkan percepatan yang signifikan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Melalui penerbitan Taksonomi untuk Keuangan Berkelanjutan Indonesia (TKBI) Edisi 2 pada tahun 2025, OJK memperluas cakupan aktivitas ekonomi berkelanjutan dengan menambahkan sektor transportasi dan pergudangan, konstruksi dan real estat, serta sektor AFOLU, termasuk kehutanan dan perkebunan kelapa sawit. Perluasan taksonomi ini meningkatkan kompleksitas penerapan tata kelola berkelanjutan bagi industri perbankan, karena bank dituntut untuk melakukan klasifikasi pembiayaan secara lebih granular dan memastikan keselarasan portofolio kredit dengan kriteria keberlanjutan yang semakin luas dan detail.

Sejalan dengan perkembangan tersebut, industri perbankan menghadapi tantangan dalam memperkuat tata kelola internal, khususnya terkait kesiapan data, sistem pelaporan, dan kapasitas sumber daya manusia. Tantangan ini semakin meningkat dengan adanya rencana penerapan Standar Pengungkapan Keberlanjutan (SPK) nasional yang mengadopsi IFRS S1 dan IFRS S2, yang diperkirakan berlaku efektif mulai 1 Januari 2027. Standar ini menuntut keterbukaan yang lebih tinggi atas risiko dan peluang keberlanjutan, termasuk Risiko Iklim, strategi transisi, serta pengaruhnya terhadap kinerja dan posisi keuangan Bank. Permata Bank memandang bahwa keseluruhan dinamika tersebut memerlukan penyesuaian tata kelola pelaporan, integrasi lintas fungsi, serta penguatan pengawasan oleh Direksi dan Dewan Komisaris.

The development of the sustainable finance regulatory framework in Indonesia has shown significant acceleration in recent years. With the issuance of the Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance Indonesia (TKBI) Edition 2 in 2025, the Financial Services Authority expanded the scope of sustainable economic activities by adding the transportation and warehousing, construction and real estate, and AFOLU sectors, including forestry and palm oil plantations. This taxonomy expansion increases the complexity of implementing sustainable governance for the banking industry, as banks are required to classify financing more granularly and ensure alignment of credit portfolios with broader and more detailed sustainability criteria.

In line with these developments, the banking industry faces challenges in strengthening internal governance, particularly in relation to data readiness, reporting systems, and human capital capacity. These challenges are further intensified by the planned implementation of the national Sustainability Disclosure Standards, which adopt IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 and are expected to become effective from 1 January 2027. The standards require enhanced transparency on sustainability-related risks and opportunities, including Climate Risk, transition strategies, and their impact on the Bank's performance and financial position. Permata Bank views these developments as requiring adjustments to reporting governance, stronger cross-functional integration, and enhanced oversight by the Board of Directors and the Board of Commissioners.

Oleh karena itu, selain memperkuat aspek tata kelola dan kesiapan internal, diperlukan pula upaya peningkatan literasi dan komunikasi yang efektif kepada pemangku kepentingan agar implementasi standar pengungkapan dapat memberikan nilai yang optimal.

At the same time, an additional challenge arises from relatively low market awareness of sustainability issues and disclosures. This may create an expectation gap between increasingly stringent regulatory transparency requirements and stakeholders' level of understanding and appreciation of sustainability information disclosed by banks. Accordingly, beyond strengthening governance and internal readiness, there is also a need to enhance stakeholder literacy and communication to ensure that the implementation of the disclosure standards delivers meaningful value.

In response to regulatory changes and increasing stakeholder expectations, Permata Bank has adjusted its policies, procedures, and governance and risk management framework to align with current regulations. In addition to strengthening its governance framework, the Bank has also integrated the identification of challenges and improvement measures for the implementation of Sustainable Finance into its Sustainable Finance Action Plan, which is prepared and annually evaluated. ## Type 2 Assurance

SRAI verifies the topic of **Product and Data Security**, and **Customer Privacy**, the Company has established internal data security policies approved by the Board of Directors, with regular reporting and monthly quality control meetings. To identify system vulnerabilities, the Company uses regular assessment forms accessible to customers. It also utilizes cyber threat intelligence tools to monitor data leaks and map threat patterns. The Company is currently exploring the use of AI and is expected to implement it to enhance service delivery and improve communication of products and services to customers. Regarding **Environmental Management and Climate Change**, the Company is still developing its Climate Risk Management Stress Test (CRMS), with initial testing conducted using proxy data. In the coming year, it plans to focus on collecting financed Greenhouse Gases (GHG) emissions data by preparing tools to obtain more accurate information. Additionally, Scope 1 and Scope 2 emission calculations have not been externally verified, and portfolio monitoring is conducted monthly by the risk team and reported to management.
